en.name: Earth and celestial globe, the so-called 'St. Gallen Globe'
description: For many years, the so-called St. Gallen Globe, one of the prized objects of Swiss cultural history, was a source of contention. The globe featuring Mercator maps of the earth and the celestial sphere was created by Tilemann Stella in northern Germany towards the end of the sixteenth century, as a document discovered in 2016 reveals. Although they were not suitable for navigation, globes were extremely popular in the early modern period. What makes the St. Gallen Globe so special is its combination of world and celestial globes. Entitled as a gift, which, however, was later satisfied, the globe was incorporated in the library of the Abbey of St Gallen where it was kept until 1712. During the Second War of Villmergen the globe was robbed and carted off to Zürich where it was displayed in the Wasserkirche (Water Church). St Gallen demanded the return of the globe, but to no avail. When the Swiss National Museum was established in 1898, the globe passed into the hands of the Swiss Confederation; it has been on display in the museum ever since. The dispute over the treasure, which went down in Swiss history as the cultural heritage conflict between Zürich and St Gallen, was only resolved in 2006 when the St Gallen Abbey library received a true copy of the contested globe.
keywords: scientific Instruments; terrestrial and cellestial globe; St. Gallen Globus

ar.name: زاوية سيدي شيحة.
description:
تؤدّي بوّابة الزاوية الرئيسيّة إلى سقيفة أو دهليز ينفتح مباشرةً على الفناء الداخلي ممّا يشكّل اختلافاً عن بقيّة الأبنية في المدينة القديمة؛ ويمكن تفسير هذه الخاصّية بوظيفة الزاوية التي كان عليها أن تتواجد في مكان مكشوف. غطي المدخل بقبّة مسطّحة تعرف باسم "ظهر السلحفاة"، وزين بزخارف جصية تبرز تأثيرا تركيا جليا.  
ينتظم الفناء الداخلي على شكل مستطيل، تحيط بجهاته الأربعة أروقة تستند على عقود حدوية متجاوزة، محمولة على اثنتي عشر عموداً تمّ الاستعاضة عنها لاحقاً بدعائم.  
الفناء مكسو بمربعات من الزليج صنعت في حيّ القلالين في المدينة القديمة في تونس، الذي وفر، على مدى عدّة قرون، كل متطلّبات تونس من كافّة أنواع القاشاني.  
تتميّز القاعة الواسعة التي تضمّ رفات سيدي شيحة ورفات ابنه أحمد وكذلك رفات إحدى حفيداته، بغنى الزليج الذي يغطّيها. فالقباب تلفت الانتباه بشكل خاص، إذ أنّها تشكّل قبوةً نصف أسطوانة أصغر حجماً من قبوة ضريح سيدي محرز وتربة الباي. في نفس الوقت، تختلف عنهما بشكلها الذي يضمّ زخارف جصية تركية الأصل، على هيئة مزهريات تحيط بالقبة من جهاتها الأربع. تنتهي هذه القبوة من طرفيها الأيمن والأيسر بقبتين تذكران، في كل تفاصيلهما، بقباب السليمانية والباشية العائدة إلى القرن 12 الهجري / 18 الميلادي. غير أن قباب سيدي شيحة أعظم حجما وأغزر زخرفة، وهاتان القبتان ترتكزان على عضادتي دعم ضخمتان يغطيهما الرخام وعلى أنصاف أعمدة مدمجة في الحائط .  
  
يأوي هذا الضريح بين جدرانه اليوم المركز الوطني لفن الخط.

يقع ضريح سيدي شيحة في حي الحلفاويين، وهو حي شعبي بالمدينة العتيقة لتونس. يرجع الضريح إلى الفترة الحسينية (القرن 13 للهجرة / القرن 17 للميلاد)؛ ويحتضن اليوم المركز الوطني لفن الخط. تعلو المدخل الضخم قبة مسطحة تعرف تحت اسم "ظهر السلحفاة"؛ وغطيت بجصيات ذات تأثير تركي. وتتميز القاعة الفسيحة التي تحتضن قبر سيدي شيحة وكذا قبري ابنه أحمد وقبر إحدى حفيداته بغنى تلبيساتها الجدارية المتكونة من بلاطات الزليج.
history: قام الوزير مصطفى خزندار الذي كان يؤمن بسيدي شيحة إيماناً كبيراً بالإسهام في تشييد هذا الضريح، وكان ذلك عند ولادة ابنه محمد عام 1269 هجري/ 1852 ميلادي؛ واستمرت أعمال البناء خمس سنوات، حتى عام 1274 هجري/ 1857 ميلادي.
keywords: زخرفة زهرية؛ عمارة جنائزيّة؛ عمارة دينيّة؛ ضريح؛ زاوية؛ فن الخط.
partner: Ministry of Culture, National Institute of Cultural Heritage

en.name: Zawiya of Sidi Shiha.
description:
The great door of the *zawiya* leads into a *sqifa* or hallway which opens on to the patio. This is unusual in ancient buildings in this *medina* but probably explained by the function of the *zawiya*, which must have been an open space. Above the entrance is a type of flattened dome known as a turtle-back dome, covered in stucco in the Turkish manner. The rectangular patio is flanked on four sides with porticoes carrying horseshoe arcades. These arcades were supported on 12 columns which have been replaced by buttresses.  
The patio floor is tiled with ceramic tiles originating from the Quallaline district in the Tunis Medina. This area has supplied ceramics of all kinds to Tunisians for centuries.  
The huge room housing the sepulchre of Sidi Shiha, and that of his son Ahmed and one of his grand daughters, is noted for its rich decoration of small enamelled tiles, a technique known as *zellij*. The domes are particularly notable, though the barrel-vault is smaller than that of the mausoleum of Sidi Mehrez, and the Turbe al-Bey. It differs from the latter in its Turkish influenced stuccos (vases surrounding the dome on four sides, with window openings). This vault is flanked on its left and right sides by two domes. They are both reminiscent in every detail of the domes of Slimaniya Madrasa and Baschiya Madrasa which date from the AH 12th century (AD 18th). However, the Sidi Shiha domes are larger and more ornate. They rest on two enormous buttresses covered with marble, positioned in the centre of the hall and resting on two semi-columns set in the walls. This mausoleum currently houses the National Calligraphy Centre.

Situated in Halfawiyyne, a working-class district of the Tunis Medina, the Husaynid mausoleum of Sidi Shiha (AH 13th / AD 18th century) is today home to the National Calligraphy Centre. The monumental entrance has a so called flattened turtleback dome covered by Turkish-influenced stuccos. The enormous room containing the tomb of Sidi Shiha as well as that of his son Ahmad and one of his granddaughters is noteworthy for the opulence of their ceramic tile decoration.
history: The minister Mustafa Khaznadar was devoted to Sidi Shiha and contributed to the construction of the mausoleum, which he began after the birth of his son Muhammad in 1269 (1852). The works lasted five years until 1274 (1857).
keywords: Funerary architecture; religious architecture; floral decoration; calligraphy
partner: Ministry of Culture, National Institute of Cultural Heritage

es.name: *Zawiya* de Sidi Ali Shiha
description:
La puerta monumental de la *zawiya* conduce a una *sqifa* o vestíbulo que da directamente al patio, hecho que resulta original en comparación con otros monumentos de la medina. La función de la *zawiya*, que debía ser un lugar abierto, justifica probablemente esta característica. La entrada está coronada por una cúpula vaída conocida como “caparazón de tortuga”, revestida de estucos de influencia turca.  
El patio rectangular está rodeado en sus cuatro lados por pórticos delimitados por arcos de herradura que estaban sostenidos por doce columnas, que fueron sustituidas por contrafuertes. El patio está revestido de azulejos procedentes del barrio de Qallalin, de la medina de Túnez, que abasteció durante siglos las necesidades del país relativas a todo tipo de azulejos.  
La amplia sala que alberga la sepultura de Sidi Ali Shiha, así como las de su hijo Ahmad y una de sus nietas, se caracteriza por la riqueza del revestimiento de alicer. La bóveda es más pequeña que la del mausoleo de Sidi Mehrez y la del Türbe el-Bey. Se diferencia por el modelo de estucos de influencia otomana, que representa jarrones rodeando la cúpula por sus cuatro lados, calados de ventanas. Esta bóveda está flanqueada por dos cúpulas notables, que recuerdan a las cúpulas de la Slimaniya y la Bashiya, que datan del siglo XII / XVIII. Sin embargo, las de Sidi Ali Shiha son más grandes y más ricas. Se apoyan sobre dos grandes contrafuertes recubiertos de mármol y situados en medio de la sala, así como sobre semicolumnas encajadas en las paredes.  
Este mausoleo alberga actualmente el Centro Nacional de Caligrafía.

Situado en al-Halfawin, un barrio popular de la medina de Túnez, el mausoleo de Sidi Shiha, de época husayní (siglo XIII / XIX), alberga actualmente el Centro Nacional de Caligrafía. La entrada monumental está coronada por una cúpula vaída, conocida como “caparazón de tortuga”, recubierta de estucos de influencia turca. La amplia sala que alberga las sepulturas de Sidi Shiha, su hijo Ahmad y una de sus nietas se caracteriza por la riqueza de su revestimiento de azulejos.
history: Por su gran devoción a Sidi Ali Shiha, el ministro Mustafa Jaznadar contribuyó a la edificación del mausoleo, que empezó tras el nacimiento de su hijo Muhammad, en el año 1269 / 1852. Las obras duraron cinco años.
keywords: arquitectura funeraria; arquitectura religiosa; decoración floral; caligrafía
partner: Ministry of Culture, National Institute of Cultural Heritage

fr.name: Zaouia de Sidi Chiha.
description:
La porte monumentale de la *zaouia* mène vers une *skifa* ou vestibule qui ouvre directement sur le patio, ce qui est une originalité par rapport aux autres monuments de la médina. La fonction de la *zaouia*, qui devait être un endroit ouvert, explique probablement cette caractéristique.  
  
L'entrée est surmontée d'une coupole plate connue sous le nom de “dos de tortue”. Elle est revêtue de stucs d'influence turque.  
  
Le patio rectangulaire est entouré sur quatre côtés par des portiques portant des arcades outrepassées qui étaient portées sur douze colonnes qui ont ensuite été remplacées par des contreforts.  
  
Le patio est revêtu de carreaux de céramique provenant du quartier de Qallaline dans la médina de Tunis, qui a fourni durant des siècles les besoins de la Tunisie en tout genre de carreaux de céramique.  
  
La vaste salle abritant la sépulture de Sidi Chiha ainsi que celle de son fils Ahmed et de l'une de ses petites-filles se caractérise par la richesse de son revêtement de zelliges. Les coupoles attirent particulièrement l'attention en présentant une voûte en berceau plus petite que celle du mausolée de Sidi Mehrez et de Tourbet el-Bey. Elle en diffère par son modèle de stucs d'influence turque représentant des vases entourant la coupole des quatre côtés, ajourés de fenêtres. Cette voûte est bordée sur ses deux côtés gauche et droit par deux coupoles. Celles-ci rappellent en tous points les coupoles, qui remontent au XIIe siècle H (XVIIIe siècle J.-C.), de la Slimaniya et de la Bachiya. Toutefois, celles de Sidi Chiha sont plus grandes et plus riches. Elles s'appuient sur deux énormes contreforts recouverts de marbre et placés au milieu de la salle, ainsi que sur des demi-colonnes encastrées dans les murs.  
  
Ce mausolée abrite actuellement le Centre national de la calligraphie.

Situé à Halfaouine, un quartier populaire de la médina de Tunis, le mausolée de Sidi Chiha, d'époque husseinite (XIIIe siècle H / XVIIIe siècle J.-C.), abrite aujourd'hui le Centre national de la calligraphie. L'entrée monumentale est surmontée d'une coupole plate connue sous le nom de “dos de tortue”. Elle est revêtue de stucs d'influence turque. La vaste salle abritant la sépulture de Sidi Chiha ainsi que celle de son fils Ahmed et de l'une des ses petites-filles se caractérise par la richesse de son revêtement en carreaux de céramique.
history: Vouant une grande dévotion à Sidi Chiha, le ministre Mustapha Khaznadar contribua à la réalisation du mausolée, qu'il entreprit suite à la naissance de son fils Mohamed en 1269 H / 1852 J.-C. Les travaux durèrent cinq ans jusqu'à 1274 H / 1857 J.-C.
keywords: Architecture funéraire; architecture religieuse; décoration florale; calligraphie.
partner: Ministry of Culture, National Institute of Cultural Heritage

ar.name: طبق.
description:
طبق كبير من النحاس الأحمر المغطى بالقصدير ذو ساق قصيرة، وقاعدة محدبة، وجوانب قليلة العمق مستديرة، وحافة مسطحة مدببة الأطراف. تم تصنيع الطبق من صفيحة واحدة مستديرة من المعدن، وثقبه بعدم إتقان عند الحافة، في حين تم تزيين السطح بالتحزيز. وللحافة شريط من الزخارف الملتفة وأرضية مهشرة تكمل زخارف الحافة. تم تزيين سطح الطبق بستة إطارات تحتوي تركيباً متناوباً من شعار بالخط الكوفي والزخارف الزهرية، تفصل بينها حليات دائرية مزخرفة، وشرائط من اللفائف البسيطة من الأعلى والأسفل. يظهر على قاعدة الطبق نجمة متشابكة بتفاصيل هندسية ضمن حلية وإطار من اللفائف، وفي مركز النجمة حلية تتضمن شعاراً مركباً محاطاً بنقش متصل. يتألف الشعار من منديل في الحقل الأعلى، وكأس مزين بعلبة أقلام بين زوج من القرون الحاوية على المساحيق، وكأس آخر في الحقل السفلي. يرتبط هذا النوع من الشعارات بالسلطان قايتباي وضباطه واثنين من خلفائه، مما يؤرخ القطعة في أواخر القرن التاسع- أوائل العاشر/ أواخر الخامس عشر- أوائل السادس عشر.  
تمكن جيمس ألن من قراءة الكتابة عام 1969، وهي على الشكل التالي: "بلغت من العليا أعلا المراتب/ وقارنك التوفيق من كل جانب/ ولا زلت مرغوباً إليك وباسطا/ يمينك في الدنيا بنيل المطالب". لم تتم زخرفة الجزء السفلي من الطبق، لكنه يحمل نقشين منفذين بشكل سيئ، وقد قرأها ألن على الشكل التالي: "مما عمل برسم…السيفي إينال الأشقر"، والباقي غير مقروء، إلا أن ألن يعتقد أنها قد تكون محاولة لنسخ عبارة "المقر الأشرف".

ثمَّة شعارات مؤلفة من محرمة في القاطع العلوي، وكأس تحمل علبة أقلام مُقحمة بين زوجين من قرون المسحوق في القاطع الأوسط، وكأس في القاطع السفلي. يُعزى هذا النمط الخاص من الشعارات، إلى السلطان قايتباي، وموظفيه، واثنين من خلفائه.
holder: المتحف الملكي، المتحف الوطني في اسكتلندا NMS.
dates: أواخر القرن التاسع- أوائل العاشر/ أواخر الخامس عشر- أوائل السادس عشر.
keywords: شعار.

en.name: Dish.
description:
A large tinned copper dish with a low foot, a slightly convex base and shallow rounded sides; it has a flat rim with a cusped edge. Made out of a single circular plate of metal, the dish has a crudely punched hole in the rim, while the surface is enhanced by incising. The rim has a scroll band and hatched areas which complement the scallops on the rim. In the well of the dish there are six compartments that contain an alternating composition of an inscription in *kufic* script and floral decoration, separated by interlacing decorative roundels, and with bands of simple scroll-work at the top and bottom. On the base of the dish there is an interlaced star with geometric detailing, set within a roundel and bordered by scrolling. The centre of the star has a roundel containing a composite blazon surrounded by a cursive inscription. The blazon consists of a napkin in the upper field, a cup charged with a pen-case between a pair of powder horns in the centre field, and another cup in the lower field. This particular type of blazon is associated with Sultan Qaytbay, his officials and two of his successors, a fact which suggests a date of the late AH 9th–early 10th / AD late 15th–early 16th century.  
The inscription has been deciphered by James Allan (1969): ‘You have reached the highest rank as regards greatness, and good fortune is associated with you on every side; may you not cease to be in demand and to stretch forth your right hand in the world by obtaining your wishes.’ The underside is not decorated but holds two very poorly written inscriptions. These – according to Allan – read: ‘This was made for … (?) Sayf al-Din Aynal al-Ashqar.’ The remaining word is virtually illegible but Allan suggests that it might be an attempt to copy the words ‘al-muqarr al-ashraf’.

Many late Mamluk artefacts show blazons that consist of a napkin in the upper field, a cup charged with a pen case between a pair of powder horns in the centre field and a cup in the lower field. This particular type of blazon is associated with Sultan Qaytbay, his officials and two of his successors.
dates: Hegira late 9th–early 10th century / AD late 15th–early 16th century.
keywords: Blazon; Sultan Qaytbay; emblems; coat of arms; inscription; calligraphy; floral decoration

es.name: Fuente
description:
Fuente de cobre estañado con pie bajo, base ligeramente convexa, pared curva de poca altura y ala rematada en un borde con lóbulos y picos. Hecha con una sola plancha de metal, tiene una tosca perforación en el ala y toda su superficie está incisa. En el ala, además del borde con festones rayados en su interior, presenta una banda de roleos. La pared está dividida en seis espacios en los que alternan inscripciones cúficas y motivos florales, separados por el entrelazado de las bandas que los enmarcan. En el fondo se ve una estrella formada por la intersección de círculos; ocupa el centro un blasón compuesto inscrito en una banda circular con una inscripción en cursiva. El blasón comprende una servilleta en el campo superior, una copa con un estuche de plumas y cuernos a los lados en el centro y otra copa en el campo inferior. Este tipo de blasón está asociado al sultán Qaytbay, sus altos cargos y dos de sus sucesores, lo que permite datar el objeto.  
James Allan (1969) descifró la inscripción: “Has alcanzado el más alto rango de la grandeza, la fortuna te acompaña en todas las cosas; ojalá no ceses en ser afamado ni en extender más tu mano derecha en el mundo cumpliendo tus deseos”. La parte posterior no está decorada, pero sí presenta dos inscripciones pobremente escritas que, según Allan, rezan: “Esto se hizo para ... (?) Sayf al-Din Aynal al-Ashqar”. El resto es ilegible, aunque Allan sugiere que podría ser “al-muqarr al-ashraf”.

Muchos objetos de finales del periodo mameluco muestran blasones compuestos con una servilleta en el campo superior, una copa con un estuche de plumas y flanqueada por cuernos para pólvora en el centro y otra copa en el campo inferior. Este blasón está asociado al sultán Qaytbay, sus altos cargos y dos de sus sucesores.
dates: Finales del siglo IX-principios del X de la Hégira / XV-XVI d. C.
keywords: blasón; sultán Qaytbay

fr.name: Plat.
description: Grand plat en cuivre étamé sur court piédouche, à fond légèrement convexe, marli cintré en creux, aile horizontale chantournée. Mis en forme à partir d'une plaque de métal circulaire, ce plat au bord perforé présente une surface entièrement couverte d'un décor incisé. Le pourtour est orné d'un bandeau de rinceaux et de zones hachurées intégrées aux festons. Le marli est divisé en six compartiments à compositions alternées d'inscriptions en coufique et d'ornements floraux séparées par des rosettes entrelacées prises entre deux bandeaux de simples enroulements. Le fond du bassin reçoit une étoile faite d'entrelacs géométriques inscrits dans un cercle bordé de rinceaux. Le centre de cet ornement est occupé par un rondeau à blason composite entouré d'une inscription en cursives. Il représente de haut en bas une serviette, une coupe dans laquelle est placé un plumier entre une paire de cornes à poudre et une seconde coupe. Ce type particulier de blason est lié au sultan Qaytbay, ses hauts dignitaires et deux de ses successeurs, ce qui suggère une date de fabrication fin IXe-début Xe siècle H (fin XVe-début XVIe siècle J.-C.).

De nombreux objets de la période mamelouke tardive présentent des blasons composés, de haut en bas, d’une serviette, d’une coupe dans laquelle est placé un plumier entre une paire de cornes à poudre et d’une seconde coupe. Ce type particulier de blason est lié au sultan Qaytbay, à ses hauts dignitaires et à deux de ses successeurs.
dates: Fin IXe-début Xe siècle de l’Hégire (fin XVe-début XVIe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: blasons ; sultan Qaytbay

ar.name: جرة.
description:
الجرة كروية الشكل، عنقها طويل ونحيف، وعلى سطحها خطوط متوازية، متقاربة في الأعلى، وقد نفذت خلال صناعتها، فبدت كأنها محفورة عليه. مقبضاها يرتكزان على عنقها بشكل زرين. أما لونها الأصلي فهو الأسود المكسو بدهان أبيض، وعلى سطح بطن الجرة زخرفة تشبه الخط الكوفي، تنتهي في الأسفل. وبين العنق والبطن زخرفة معروفة في الفن الإسلامي، تمثل رسوماً مبسطة لشجر النخيل، هي على شكل ضفائر مؤلفة من صور قلوب.  
وجد عالم الآثار أنتونيو ساليناز الجرةً مع نماذج أخرى داخل قوس يصل إلى غرفة في الدير التابع لكنيسة مارتورانا (المعذبة) والمشيد حوالي عام 588/ 1193.  
يظهر على القسم السفلي من الجرة شَق سببه سوء الشي خلال صناعتها، ولما رآها الناس غير صالحة لحفظ السوائل تركوها مع البقايا التالفة لملء قوس البناء المذكور.
من الممكن أن تكون هذه الجرة قد استعملت كآنية للمواد الغذائية. وبالرغم من ذلك، فقد استخدمت كمادة للبناء استعملت لطمر قبة لأنها كانت تحوي عيبا يرتبط بعملية الشي، جعلها غير صالحة كآنية.
holder: BB CC AA ب ب  ك ك  أأ  (مكتب المحافظة على الممتلكات الثقافية والفنية) مدينة باليرمو.
place: كنيسة القديسة مريم الأميرال والمعروفة بـ: مارتورانا ( أي المعذبة ).
keywords: جرة؛ خزف صقلي نورمندي؛ خط كوفي.

en.name: Jar.
description:
This two-handled globular jar with a long, narrow neck is marked along its body with numerous parallel furrows, made when it was turned, which come together towards the top. There are button-shaped grips on the top of the handles. It is decorated in white on a dark engobe (slip) with central horizontal lines alternating with pseudo-epigraphic motifs in *kufic* characters and oblique lines below. The double braid of linked hearts is a typical Islamic motif deriving from stylisation of the palm tree.  
The jar was found, together with other pieces, by the archaeologist Antonio Salinas in the space between the intrados of a vault and the floor of a room of the monastery attached to the Martorana Church built around 1193. The crack in the lower part of the amphora, caused by a firing defect, indicates that the piece, a kiln reject no longer usable as a container, was used to fill vaults in large residences in the first half of the 12th century.
This jar was intended as a container for foodstuffs, but was actually used as a building material to fill a vault because it had a firing defect that made it unsuitable for use as a container.
holder: Sopraintendenza Beni Culturali e Ambientali, Palermo.
place: Church of Santa Maria dell’Ammiraglio, known as the Martorana.
keywords: Siculo-Norman; ceramic; jar; calligraphy; kufic

es.name: Cántaro.
description:
Este cántaro globular de dos asas presenta un cuello alto y estrecho. A lo largo del cuerpo se aprecian numerosos surcos paralelos realizados durante el torneado, más próximos entre sí en la parte superior. Las asas presentan un agarradero en la parte de arriba en forma de botón. Está decorada en blanco sobre engobe oscuro, con líneas horizontales en el centro que se intercalan con motivos pseudoepigráficos en caracteres cúficos y líneas oblicuas debajo. El arranque del cuello presenta una doble trenza de corazones concatenados, típico motivo islámico que resulta de la estilización de la palma.  
El cántaro fue hallado junto con otros ejemplares por el arqueólogo Antonio Salinas en el espacio entre el extradós de una bóveda y el suelo de encima de una estancia del monasterio anexo a la iglesia de la Martorana, construido alrededor del año 1193. La grieta presente en la parte inferior del cántaro, debida a un defecto de cocción, indica que el objeto, sobrante de horno e inservible como contenedor, sirvió para rellenar las bóvedas de las grandes viviendas de la primera mitad del siglo XII.

Este cántaro debería haberse utilizado como contenedor de alimentos, sin embargo se empleó como material de construcción, para rellenar una bóveda, ya que presentaba un defecto de cocción que lo hacía inútil como recipiente.
holder: Superintendencia de Bienes Culturales y Artísticos de Palermo.
place: Iglesia de Santa María del Almirante, vulgo “de la Martorana”.
keywords: cerámica sículo-normanda; cántaro; caligrafía

fr.name: Jarre.
description:
Cette jarre en forme de globe, à deux anses et à col haut et étroit, porte sur toute la panse de nombreux sillons parallèles exécutés pendant le tournage, plus serrés dans la partie supérieure ; sur leur partie supérieure, les anses comportent une prise en forme de bouton. Elle est décorée en blanc sur engobe sombre, avec des lignes horizontales au centre, alternant avec des motifs pseudo-épigraphiques en caractères coufiques et des lignes obliques en bas ; à la base du col, la double tresse à cœurs enchaînés est un motif islamique typique, dérivé de la stylisation du palmier.  
Cette jarre fut trouvée, avec d'autres exemplaires, par l'archéologue Antonio Salinas, dans l'espace situé entre l'intrados d'une voûte et le plancher d'une pièce du monastère annexe à l'église de la Martorana, construit vers 1193. La fente visible dans la partie inférieure de la jarre, provoquée par un défaut de cuisson, indique que l'objet, devenu inutilisable en tant que contenant, fut utilisé comme déchet de four : il avait pour fonction de combler les voûtes des grandes demeures, durant la première moitié du XIIe siècle.

Cette jarre a dû être utilisée comme récipient pour des produits alimentaires. Elle fut pourtant utilisée comme matériau de construction servant à combler une voûte, car elle présentait un défaut de cuisson qui la rendait inutilisable en tant que récipient.
holder: Direction des biens culturels et environnementaux de Palerme.
place: Église Santa Maria dell’Ammiraglio, dite de la Martorana.
keywords: céramique arabo-normande ; jarre ; calligraphie

it.name: Giara.
description: La giara di forma globulare biansata con collo alto e stretto è segnata lungo il corpo da numerose solcature parallele eseguite durante la tornitura, più fitte nella parte superiore; le anse hanno una presa in alto a forma di bottone. È decorata in bianco su ingobbio scuro con linee orizzontali al centro intervallate da motivi pseudo-epigrafici in caratteri cufici e linee oblique in basso; alla base del collo la doppia treccia a cuori concatenati è un tipico motivo islamico desunto dalla stilizzazione dell'albero di palma. La giara fu trovata, insieme ad altri esemplari, dall'archeologo Antonio Salinas nello spazio tra l'intradosso di una volta ed il sovrastante piano di calpestio di una stanza del monastero annesso alla chiesa della Martorana, costruito intorno al 1193. La fenditura presente nella parte inferiore dell'anfora, causata da un difetto di cottura, indica che l'oggetto, non più utilizzabile come contenitore, fosse stato utilizzato, come scarto di fornace, con funzione di riempimento delle volte delle grandi dimore della prima metà del XII secolo.

La giara doveva essere usata come contenitore per derrate alimentari. Essa venne però impiegata come materiale edilizio, nel riempimento di una volta in quanto presentava un difetto di cottura che la rendeva inadatta come recipiente.
holder: Soprintendenza BB CC AA di Palermo.
place: Chiesa di Santa Maria dell’Ammiraglio, detta della Martorana.
keywords: ceramica siculo-normanna; giara; calligrafia; cufico

en.name: Church of Salvador
description: This Church existed before 1271, but the present-day structure dates from the beginning of the 16th century, when the Bishop of Évora, D. Afonso de Portugal, was its patron. Note the crossed Gothic vaulting with five bosses, and ribbed bays resting on addorsed *colonnettes*, which makes it appear that the old walls were used for the Manueline remodelling.The sacristy retains part of its original Late Gothic structure.

ar.name: مجمَّع بايزيد الثاني.
description:
يعتبر مجمَّع بايزيد الثاني أشبه بنمط الكليات، حيث يضم مجموعة كبيرة من المباني يتوسطها مسجد. يقع المجمَّع على الشاطئ الشمالي لنهر تونكا، ويشغل مساحة قدرها حوالي 22.000 متر مربع، محاطة بأسوار. يتألف المجمع من مسجد وداري ضيافة صغيرتين مجاورتين له ومدرسة ومشفى ومطعم للفقراء ومستودعات للطعام وحمام مزدوج (خارج جدران الفناء) وجسر. الحمام الواقع في الجانب الغربي من المجمَّع لم يبقَ منه شيء. أما الجسر الواقع على نهر تونكا، والذي بني لربط الكلية بالمدينة، فهو ذو عقود مدببة تمتد لمسافة كبيرة.  
  
تقع المدرسة والمشفى في الجهة الغربية من الفناء المركزي الذي يتم الدخول إليه عبر بوابة في الجدار الشمالي للفناء الخارجي، ويقع مطعم الفقراء في الجهة الشرقية، أما المسجد ففي الجهة الجنوبية. يوجد في الجانب الشرقي لبوابة الفناء نافورة ماء باسم سنان آغا. تقع الداران الصغيرتان على الجانبين الشرقي والغربي من المسجد ذي القبة المركزية الواحدة والشكل المكعب. وتشتمل كل من الدارين على أربعة إيوانات وتسع حجيرات. أما الفناء مستطيل الشكل الواقع إلى الشمال من قاعة الصلاة فيتم الدخول إليه عبر ثلاث بوابات في جدرانه الشمالية والشرقية والغربية. يحيط بالفناء من جهاته الأربع أروقة مقببة، ويوجد في وسطه نافورة ماء من الرخام. الرواق، المخصص للمتأخرين بالقدوم، ذو فسحات سبع ويمتد على طول واجهة المسجد، وهو مزخرف بمقرنصات، كما أنه أعلى من الأروقة الأخرى. تبرز مئذنتا المبنى من الزوايا الخارجية لداري الضيافة، وهما مخدَّدتان بارتفاع 38 م وبقطر 3.25 م، ولكل منهما شرفة. أما القبة التي تغطي قاعة الصلاة المربعة فيصل قطرها إلى حوالي 20.55 م، وتستند على مثلثات كروية.  
  
صُنع المحراب والمنبر ومقصورة السلطان من الرخام. الزخرفة الهندسية للمنبر والمنصة تسترعي الانتباه. المصاريع الخشبية للأبواب والخزانات والنوافذ ذات زخارف غنية؛ فبالإضافة إلى الزخرفة الهندسية والزهرية، تشتمل أعمال الزينة على نقوش متنوعة.  
  
تشغل المدرسة ذات الطابق الواحد مساحةً مستطيلة الشكل. وتضم فناء مفتوحاً يحيط بجوانبه الأربعة أروقة، ويتوسطه نافورة ماء مدمَّرة. يقع المدخل في منتصف الجانب الشرقي. تحتوي الأجنحة الشمالية والجنوبية والغربية على 18 قاعة للطلاب في القسم الخلفي للأروقة؛ وهذه القاعات، إضافة إلى حجيرات الأروقة، كلها مقبَّبة. غرفة الصف عبارة عن حجرة مربعة الشكل تبلغ مساحتها 7.36x7.37 م، تقع في وسط الجانب الشرقي، وتغطيها قبة كبيرة. وهناك مكتبة مبنية على شكل شرفة في دور شبه طابقي (ميزانين) عند الجدار الشرقي لغرفة الصف. يقع المشفى في الجانب الشرقي للمسجد ويتألف من مبنى رئيسي وفناءين. يتخذ المبنى الرئيسي شكلاً سداسي الأضلاع، ويتألف من مساحة مركزية مقبَّبة تضم ستة إيوانات مقببة مفتوحة على المبنى، وتفصل بينها غرف مقببة أيضاً. والإيوان الجنوبي أكثر عمقاً ويمتد إلى الخارج.  
  
يتألف مطعم الفقراء الواقع في شرق المسجد من مطبخ وفرن وحجرة طعام وخزانة لحفظ الأدوات ومستودع وإسطبلات؛ وقد بنيت في مجموعتين من المنشآت. واليوم تستولي جامعة تراقيا على المشفى والمدرسة، وهما مفتوحان للزوار بوصفهما متحفاً للصحة ومتحفاً للفنون الجميلة.
artist: هناك آراء عديدة تتعلق بهوية المعمار. يرى بعض الباحثين أن المجمَّع بني على يد المهندس خير الدين، ويرى آخرون أن المهندس يعقوب شاه بن سلطان شاه هو من بناه. أما الخطاط فهو الشيخ حمد الله.
keywords: إديرن؛ بناء لأغراض دينية؛ جسر؛ دار الضيافة؛ زخرفة زهرية؛ زخرفة كتابية؛ زخرفة هندسية؛ كلية؛ مدرسة؛ مشفى؛ مطعم الفقراء.

en.name: Bayezid II Complex (*külliye*).
description:
The Bayezid II Complex is of the *külliye* type comprising a large collection of buildings of which the mosque is central. Located on the north shore of the Tunca River, it occupies an area of some 22,000 sq m and is surrounded by walls. It consists of a mosque, two guest-houses (*tabhane*s) adjoining the mosque, a *madrasa*, a hospital (*darüşşifa*), a soup-kitchen (*imaret*), food-storage areas, and (outside the courtyard walls) a double bathhouse (*hammam*) and a bridge. The double bathhouse at the west of the complex no longer survives. The bridge over the Tunca River, built to connect the *külliye* to the city, has large spans of pointed arches.  
The *madrasa* and *darüşşifa* are on the western side of the central courtyard, which is accessed through a gate in the north wall of the outer courtyard. The *imaret* is on the eastern side, while the mosque is on the south side. On the east side of the courtyard gate is the fountain of Sinan Ağa.  
The single-domed, cubic mosque is adjoined by *tabhane*s on its east and west sides. Each of these guest-houses has a four-*iwan* plan and contains nine bays. The rectangular courtyard, north of the prayer hall, is accessed through three gates in its north, east and west walls. The courtyard is surrounded on all four sides by domed porticoes and has a marble fountain in the centre. The seven-bay portico for latecomers extends along the façade of the mosque and its central dome, decorated with *muqarnas*, is higher than the others. The building's two minarets rise from the outer corners of the *tabhane*s. Each has one balcony, both are almost 38 m high, and have grooved bodies, 3.25 m in diameter. The dome covering the square prayer hall is approximately 20.55 m in diameter and rises on pendentives.  
The *mihrab*, *minbar* and sultan's loge are all made of marble. The geometric decoration on the *minbar* and the gallery are noteworthy. The wooden door wings, cupboards and window shutters are richly decorated. In addition to geometric and floral decoration, the ornament includes various inscriptions.  
The single-storied *madrasa* occupies a rectangular area and has an open courtyard with porticoes on all four sides; the fountain in the centre of the courtyard is in a ruined state. The entrance is in the middle of the east side. The north, south and west wings contain a total of 18 students' cells behind the porticoes. Both the portico bays and the students' cells are domed. The classroom is a square space of approximately 7.36 m x 7.37 m located in the centre of the west side. It is covered with a large dome, and the mezzanine built onto its east wall, which looks like a balcony, is the library.  
The *darüşşifa* to the west of the mosque is made up of a main building and two courtyards. The main building is hexagonal and consists of a central domed space with six *iwan*s opening onto it, and rooms between the *iwan*s. Both the *iwan*s and the rooms are each covered with a single dome. The south *iwan* is deeper than the others and extends to the outside.  
The *imaret* to the east of the mosque comprises a kitchen, oven, dining hall, pantry, storage space, and stables. It was built in two clusters of structures.  
Today the *darüşşifa* and the *madrasa* have been appropriated by Trakya University and are open to visitors as a Museum of Health and a Fine Arts Museum.

One of the monumental Ottoman complexes, it was built on the bank of the River Tunca. Covering an area of 22,000 square m the complex comprises a mosque with two *tabhane*s (guesthouse) adjoining it, a *madrasa*, a hospital, an *imaret* (soup-kitchen), storerooms within the walls, a double-bathhouse outside which has not survived, and a bridge over the river. Its foundations were laid with a ceremony attended by the sultan himself. It is known that musical therapy was applied at its hospital and its *madrasa* is said to have served for medical training.
artist: There are several opinions as to the identity of the architect. According to some researchers, the complex was built by the architect Hayreddin [Khayr al-Din], while according to others it was built by the architect Yakub Shah bin Sultan Shah. Calligrapher: Sheikh Hamdullah [Hamd Allah].
keywords: külliye; religious architecture; guest-house (tabhane); madrasa; hospital (darüşşifa); soup-kitchen (imaret); geometric decoration; floral decoration; calligraphy; bridge; Edirne

es.name: Complejo *(külliye)* de Bayezid II
description:
El complejo de Bayezid II, del tipo *külliye*, comprende un importante número de edificios alrededor de la mezquita, que ocupa la posición central. Está situado en la ribera norte del río Tunca, ocupa una superficie de 22.000 m² y está rodeado de murallas. Lo forman la mezquita, dos hospederías *(tabhane)* adyacentes a la mezquita, una madrasa, un hospital *(darüşşifa)*, un comedor público *(imaret)*, almacenes para alimentos y, en el exterior de los muros del patio, un doble *hammam* y un puente. Los baños de la zona occidental del complejo han desaparecido. El puente sobre el Tunca, construido para conectar el *külliye* con la ciudad, presenta grandes arcadas apuntadas.  
La madrasa y el *darüşşifa* dan al lado occidental del patio central, al que se entra por una puerta del muro norte del patio exterior. El *imaret* se halla en el lado este y la mezquita, en el lado sur. La fuente de Sinan Ağa está al este de la puerta del patio.  
La mezquita, cúbica y cubierta por una sola cúpula, conecta con los *tabhane* de los lados oriental y occidental. Cada uno de estos albergues tiene una estructura de cuatro *iwan* y nueve crujías. Al patio rectangular, al norte de la sala de oración, se entra por tres puertas situadas en las paredes norte, este y oeste respectivamente. El patio tiene pórticos con cúpulas en los cuatro lados y una fuente de mármol en el centro. El pórtico para los rezagados, de siete tramos, se extiende a lo largo de la fachada de la mezquita y su cúpula central, decorada con mocárabes, es mayor que las demás. Los dos alminares, de cuerpo estriado, poseen sendos balcones y miden casi 38 m de altura y 3,25 m de diámetro. Se alzan desde los ángulos exteriores de los *tabhane*. La cúpula que cubre la sala de oración, de imposta cuadrada, tiene un diámetro aproximado de 20,55 m y se sustenta sobre pechinas.  
El *mihrab*, el *minbar* y el palco del sultán son de mármol. Cabe destacar la decoración geométrica del *minbar* y de la galería. Las hojas de la puerta de madera, las alacenas y las celosías de las ventanas presentan una elaborada decoración floral y geométrica, así como diversas inscripciones.  
La madrasa, de un solo piso, ocupa una superficie rectangular, con patio descubierto de pórticos en los cuatro lados. En el centro hay una fuente en mal estado. La entrada está en el centro del lateral este. Las alas norte, sur y oeste cuentan con un total de 18 celdas para estudiantes, ubicadas detrás de los pórticos. Tanto las crujías del pórtico como las celdas de los estudiantes tienen cúpulas. El aula es un espacio de 7,36 × 7,37 m y se encuentra en el centro del lado oeste. Está cubierta con una gran cúpula y en ella hay una biblioteca en la balconada construida en el entrepiso del muro este.  
El hospital, al oeste de la mezquita, comprende un edificio principal y dos patios. La estructura principal es hexagonal y consta de un espacio central situado bajo una cúpula; a él dan seis *iwan* y diversas habitaciones repartidas entre ellos, todos cubiertos por cúpulas. El *iwan* sur es más profundo que los otros y se prolonga hacia el exterior.  
El *imaret*, al este de la mezquita, consta de cocina, horno, comedor, despensa, almacén y establos. Fue construido en dos partes.  
Hoy en día, el *darüşşifa* y la madrasa están integrados en la universidad de Trakya y permanecen abiertos al público como Museo de la Salud y Museo de Bellas Artes respectivamente.

Este complejo monumental otomano, construido a orillas del Tunca, ocupa una superficie de 22.000 m² y comprendía una mezquita con dos *tabhane* ('hospederías') adyacentes, una madrasa, un hospital, un *imaret* ('comedor público'), almacenes intramuros, unos baños dobles en el exterior (no se conservan) y un puente sobre el río. A la ceremonia de su fundación asistió el sultán en persona. Se sabe que en su hospital se hacía terapia musical y que en la madrasa se impartían clases de medicina.
artist: Sultán Bayezid II (r. 886-917 de la Hégira / 1481-1512 d. C.)
Según algunos investigadores, el complejo fue construido por el arquitecto Hayreddin. Otros opinan que su arquitecto fue Yakub Shah bin Sultan Shah. Calígrafo: Şeyh Hamdullah.
keywords: Külliye; arquitectura religiosa; casa de huéspedes (tabhane); madrasa; hospital (darüşşifa); comedor público (imaret); decoración geométrica; decoración floral; caligrafía; puente; Edirne.

fr.name: Complexe Bayézid II (*külliye*).
description:
Le complexe Bayézid II, de type *külliye*, réunit un nombre important de bâtiments autour de la mosquée qui occupe une position centrale. Situé sur la rive nord de la Tunca, il occupe une surface de 22 000 m2 environ entourée de murs. Il comprend la mosquée, deux logis de voyageurs (*tabhane*) adjacents à la mosquée, une *madrasa*, un hôpital (*darüşşifa*), une cantine populaire (*imaret*), des greniers et, hors les murs, une double maison de bains (hammam) et un pont. Les bains à l'ouest du complexe ont disparu. Le pont sur la Tunca, construit pour relier le *külliye* à la ville, présente de longues travées en arcs brisés.  
La *madrasa* et le *darüşşifa* se trouvent sur le côté ouest de la cour centrale à laquelle on accède par une porte ouverte dans le mur nord de la cour extérieure. L'*imaret* se trouve sur le côté est, la mosquée au sud. La fontaine de Sinan Ağa se trouve à l'est de la porte de la cour.  
La mosquée de forme cubique à coupole unique s'accompagne de deux *tabhane* adjacentes à l'est et à l'ouest. Chacune suit un plan à quatre *iwan* et contient neuf travées. La cour rectangulaire, au nord de la salle de prière, est accessible par trois portes percées dans les murs nord, est et ouest. La cour est entourée sur quatre côtés de portiques sous coupole et possède en son centre une fontaine de marbre. Le portique pour retardataires développe ses sept travées le long de la façade de la mosquée dont la coupole décorée de *mouqarnas* est plus élevée que les autres. Les deux minarets à fûts cannelés de près de 38 m de haut et de 3,25 m de diamètre dotés d'un balcon s'élèvent des angles extérieurs des *tabhane*. La salle de prière est couverte d'une coupole sur pendentifs d'environ 20,55 m de diamètre.  
Le *mihrab*, le *minbar* et la loge du sultan sont en marbre. Le décor géométrique du *minbar* et de la galerie est remarquable, de même que les panneaux des portes de bois, les rayonnages et les volets de fenêtres richement décorés de motifs géométriques et floraux, et de diverses inscriptions.  
La *madrasa* de plan rectangulaire sur un seul niveau possède une cour ouverte bordée de portiques sur ses quatre côtés. La fontaine centrale est en ruine. L'entrée se fait par le côté est. Les ailes nord, sud et ouest contiennent 18 cellules pour étudiants. Les travées des portiques et les cellules sont toutes à coupole. La salle de cours occupe une superficie carrée de 7,36 m de côté au centre du côté ouest. Elle est recouverte d'une vaste coupole et une bibliothèque a été aménagée dans la mezzanine en balcon du mur est.  
Le *darüşşifa* à l'ouest de la mosquée comprend un bâtiment principal et deux cours. Le bâtiment principal est hexagonal et consiste en un volume sous coupole sur lequel ouvrent six *iwan* et diverses pièces réparties entre ceux-ci. Les *iwan* et les pièces sont tous recouverts de coupoles. L'*iwan* sud est plus profond que les autres et fait saillie vers l'extérieur.  
L'*imaret* à l'est de la mosquée comprend une cuisine, un four, une salle de repas, un garde-manger, une salle de stockage et des écuries. Il a été construit en deux parties. Aujourd'hui, l'hôpital et la *madrasa* ont été intégrés à l'Université de Trakya et aménagés en Musée de la santé et Musée des beaux-arts, tous deux ouverts au public.

Parmi les complexes monumentaux ottomans, celui-ci fut construit sur la rive de la rivière Tunca. Le complexe s'étend sur 22 000 m2 et comprend la mosquée à deux *tabhane* (logements pour voyageurs), une *madrasa*, un hôpital, un *imaret* (cantine populaire), des greniers et, hors les murs, un double hammam qui n'existe plus, ainsi qu'un pont sur la rivière. Le sultan lui-même participa aux cérémonies qui ont marqué la fondation de ce complexe. Nous savons qu'une thérapie par la musique était appliquée dans cet hôpital ; par ailleurs, sa *madrasa* aurait servi à des expériences médicales.
artist: Selon certains chercheurs, le complexe a été édifié par l’architecte Hayreddin [Khayr al-Din], pour d’autres il est dû à Yakub Chah bin Sultan Chah. Calligraphe : Şeyh Hamdullah [Chaykh Hamd Allah].
keywords: külliye ; architecture religieuse ; chambres pour voyageurs (tabhane) ; madrasa ; hôpitaux (darüşşifa) ; soupe populaire (imaret) ; décoration géométrique ; décoration florale ; calligraphie ; ponts ; Edirne

tr.name: II. Bayezid Külliyesi.
description:
Büyük bir yapılar topluluğu olan II. Bayezid Külliyesi, Tunca Nehri'nin kuzey kıyısında, nehrin kenarına inşa edilmiştir. 22.000 metrekarelik geniş bir alan üzerine kurulmuş ve etrafı duvarlarla çevrilmiş külliye cami, camiye bitişik inşa edilmiş iki tabhane (misafirhane), medrese, darüsşifa (hastane), imaret, erzak depoları ile avlu duvarları dışında kalan bir çifte hamam ve köprüden oluşur. Külliyenin batısında kalan çifte hamam, bugün ayakta değildir. Külliyeyi kente bağlamak amacıyla yapılmış Tunca Nehri üzerindeki köprü, sivri kemerli büyük gözlere sahiptir.  
  
Dış avlu duvarlarının kuzeyindeki kapıdan girilen ortak avlunun batısına medrese ve darüsşifa (hastane), doğusuna imaret, kuzeyine de cami yerleştirilmiştir. Avlu kapısının doğusunda, Sinan Ağa çeşmesi bulunur.  
  
Tek kubbeli kübik *cami*nin doğu ve batı cephelerine bitişik olarak, birer tabhane inşa edilmiştir. Dokuzar birimli *tabhaneler* dört eyvanlı plan şemasına sahiptir. Harimin kuzeyindeki dikdörtgen avluya kuzey, doğu ve batı cephelerindeki üç taçkapıdan girilir. Dört yönden kubbeli revaklarla çevrilmiş avlunun ortasında mermer bir şadırvan mevcuttur. Cami cephesindeki yedi birimli son cemaat yeri revakındaki kubbelerden mukarnaslı olan ortadaki kubbe diğerlerinden daha yüksektir. Yapının iki minaresi, tabhanelerin dış köşelerinde yer alır. Tek şerefeli minarelerin yaklaşık 38 m. yükseklikteki yivli gövdeleri 3.25 m. çapındadır. Kare planlı harimi örten yaklaşık 20.55 m. çapındaki kubbeye geçiş pandantiflerle sağlanmıştır.  
  
Mihrap, minber ve hünkar mahfili mermerden inşa edilmiştir. Minber ve mahfilde geometrik süslemeler dikkati çeker. Ahşap kapı kanatları, dolap ve pencere kapakları zengin süslemelidir. Süslemeler arasında geometrik ve bitkisel desenlerin yanı sıra çeşitli yazılara da yer verilmiştir.  
  
Dikdörtgen bir alanı kaplayan *medrese*, tek katlı ve açık avlulu bir yapıdır. Dört yönden revaklarla çevrili avlunun ortasındaki şadırvan yıkılmıştır. Giriş doğu cephesinin ortasındadır. Kuzey, güney ve batı kanatlarında, revakların arkasına 18 öğrenci hücresi sıralanmıştır. Hem revak birimleri hem de öğrenci hücreleri birer kubbeye örtülüdür. Yaklaşık 7.36 x 7.37 ölçülerindeki kare planlı dershane batı kanadın ortasına yerleştirilmiştir. Büyük bir kubbeyle örtülü dershanenin doğu duvarına yapılmış balkon görünümlü asma kat kütüphanedir.  
  
Caminin batısındaki *darüşşifa*, iki avlu ile bir ana yapı kitlesinden meydana gelmektedir. Altıgen planlı ana yapı, ortadaki kubbeli merkezi mekan ile bu mekana açılan altı eyvan ve bu eyvanlar arasına yerleştirilmiş hücrelerden oluşur. Hem eyvanlar hem de hücreler birer kubbeyle örtülüdür. Diğerlerinden daha derin tutulmuş güneydeki eyvan dışa taşıntı yapar.  
  
Caminin doğusunda bulunan ve mutfak, fırın, yemekhane, kiler, depo, ahır gibi bölümlerden oluşan *imaret* iki büyük blok halinde inşa edilmiştir.  
  
Günümüzde darüşşifa ve tıp medresesi bölümleri Trakya üniversitesi'ne tahsis edilmiş olup Sağlık Müzesi ve Güzel Sanatlar Müzesi olarak ziyarete açıktır.

Osmanlı Dönemi'nin anıtsal külliyelerinden biri olan Edirne II. Bayezid Külliyesi, Tunca Nehri kıyısında inşa edilmiştir. 22000 metrekarelik geniş bir alan üzerine kurulan külliye, cami, camiye bitişik iki tabhane, medrese, darüsşifa, imaret, erzak depoları ile avlu duvarları dışında kalan bir çifte hamam (bugün ayakta değil) ve külliyeyi kente bağlayan Tunca Nehri üzerindeki köprüden oluşmaktadır. Darüsşifada, akıl hastalarına müzikle tedavi uygulandığı bilinmektedir.
artist:
Mimarının kimliği konusunda farklı görüşler bulunmaktadır. Külliye, bazı araştırmacılara göre Mimar Hayreddin, bazı araştırmacılara göre ise Mimar Yakub Şah bin Sultan Şah tarafından inşa edilmiştir.  
  
Hattat: Şeyh Hamdullah.
keywords: II. Bayezid; Edirne; külliye; dini mimari; cami; tabhane (misafirhane); medrese; darüşşifa (hastane); imaret; köprü; geometrik bezeme; bitkisel bezeme, yazı

en.name: Church of São João Evangelista
description: The Church of São João Evangelista has a Mannerist façade that is typical of Iberian models of the Jesuit Order. Sculptures of *St. Ignatius of Loyola*, *St. Francis Xavier*, *St. Stanislas* and *St. Francis of Borja* decorate the façade. The interior is dominated by a large nave with eight lateral open-vaulted chapels, an illusionary transept and a main chapel, all of which accord with the Jesuit model. On the walls of the nave, frescoes represent the Evangelists, scenes from the lives of several Jesuits and architectural and vegetal motifs. The wooden ceiling, with a *trompe l'oeil* vault and foliate paintings, is framed by two domes with allegories and *quadratura* compositions that align with the central axe. In the centre there is a panel with the Jesuit insignia “IHS”. The simplicity of the Mannerist architectural outline is combined with the richness of Baroque ornamentation, in line with the principles of the Counter-Reformation.

The Church of São João Evangelista is one of the best examples in Madeira of the integration of the Baroque with the Mannerist style. Decorated after 1647, the interior combines gilded wood carved retables, patterned and figurative *azulejos*, *trompe l´oeil* ceiling painting and frescoes on the walls of the nave and sacristy.
artist: Author of the initial project, master of the royal works: Mateus Fernandes (active 1575–1595); master stonemason Brás Fernandes (active 1629–1635); master engravers Manuel Pereira (active 1648–1660), Manuel Pereira de Almeida (active 1690–1700) painting workshop of Bento Coelho da Silveira (1648–1708)
history:
The church of São João Evangelista with its mannerist outline was built in 1629 by the Jesuits who established themselves in Madeira some time after 1570. The church was already built by 1647, but due to its monumental character and exuberance, works continued until the beginning of the 18th century. In fact, the Baroque style took over from the original Mannerist composition, and in meeting with the ideas of the Counter-Reformation, it called Christians to glorious salvation and elevated them in its artistic glory.  
With the expulsion of the Jesuits in 1760 the church was closed until 1846 at which time, aware of the monument's valuable heritage, the Civil Governor, José Silvestre Ribeiro, undertook important renovation works and returned the church to the Bishropic thereby making it once again available for religious services.
keywords: Church, São João Evangelista, Mannerism, Jesuits, fresco, gilded woodcarving, tiles, Baroque, *trompe l´oeil, quadratura*
tags: Church, São João Evangelista, Mannerism, Jesuits, fresco, gilded woodcarving, tiles, Baroque, trompe l´oeil, quadratura
partner: Institute for the Administration of Architectural and Archaeological Heritage -  IGESPAR

pt.name: *Igreja de São João Evangelista*
description: Fachada de expressiva concepção maneirista, típica dos modelos ibéricos mais divulgados pela Companhia de Jesus, ornamentada com as esculturas de *Santo Inácio de Loyola*, *São Francisco Xavier, Santo Estanislau* e *São Francisco de Borja*. O interior é dominado por uma ampla nave com oito capelas laterais intercomunicantes, falso transepto e capela-mor. Nas paredes da nave, destacam-se pinturas a fresco, de grande valor artístico, que representam os evangelistas, cenas da vida dos Jesuítas e elementos arquitectónicos e vegetalistas. A cobertura, em falsa abóbada de berço, tem uma pintura em *trompe l'œil*, cujo painel central é ornado pelas letras “IHS”, além de incluir duas cúpulas com alegorias e composições em quadratura, enquadradas por temas vegetalistas e alinhadas sobre o eixo central. Nesta igreja jesuíta, a simplicidade das linhas arquitectónicas maneiristas articula-se com a riqueza da ornamentação, adequada às novas directrizes da Contra-Reforma.

A igreja de São João Evangelista é um dos melhores exemplos da fusão das estéticas maneirista e barroca na Ilha da Madeira. A exuberante decoração do interior, iniciada em 1647 e patrocinada pelos jesuítas, combina valiosos retábulos de talha dourada, azulejaria de padrão e de desenho figurativo, com pintura presente no tecto, nos frescos da nave e na sacristia.
artist: Autor do projecto inicial: mestre das obras reais Mateus Fernandes (activo 1575–1595); mestre pedreiro: Brás Fernandes (activo 1629–1635); mestre entalhador: Manuel Pereira (activo 1648–1660); mestre entalhador: Manuel Pereira de Almeida (activo 1690–1700); oficina de Bento Coelho da Silveira (1648–1708).
history:
A igreja de São João Evangelista é um templo de traça maneirista, construído em 1629 por iniciativa dos Jesuítas, que se fixaram na Madeira após 1570. Já erguida em 1647, devido ao carácter monumental e exuberante, os trabalhos de decoração prolongaram-se até inícios do século XVIII. Nesta última fase, as composições barrocas ganharam relevo em detrimento das produções maneiristas, despertando o cristão para uma atmosfera gloriosa e de exaltação artística, tal como era preconizado pelos ideais contra-reformistas.  
Após a expulsão dos Jesuítas, em 1760, a Igreja de São João Evangelista manteve-se encerrada, até 1846, data em que o governador civil José Silvestre Ribeiro, informado das qualidades excepcionais deste monumento, promoveu obras de recuperação e devolveu-o à Diocese para ser novamente aberto ao culto.
keywords: Igreja, São João Evangelista, Maneirismo, Jesuítas, pintura a fresco, talha dourada, azulejos, Barroco.
tags: Igreja, São João Evangelista, Maneirismo, Jesuítas, pintura a fresco, talha dourada, azulejos, Barroco.

en.name: Dictionary of Three Languages
short_description: The *Dictionary of Three Languages* by Gjorgji Pullevski (1822–1893) shows the political context and coexistence of Macedonians, Albanians and Turks in the territory of Macedonia. It also provides evidence of the awakening of the national spirit of Macedonian people. The dictionary has 190 pages in paperback. It gives words in Macedonian, Albanian and Turkish in three columns. Despite its orthographic errors, the dictionary provides a valuable source for studying of the evolution of the Macedonian language.
keywords: Dictionary; coexistence

de.name: Basilika Wilten (Pfarrkirche Mariae Empfängnis)
names: Unsere liebe Frau unter den vier Säulen
description: Die Wiltener Pfarrkirche ist in ihrer baulichen Disposition ein typisches Werk von Penz, klar und einfach in der Anlage des Grundrisses, ausgewogen in der Proportion und in der Raumanlage harmonisch und abgestimmt, von wohlkalkulierter Wirkung im Prospekt. Die Weiterentwicklung des Schemas der Innsbrucker Stadtpfarrkirche führt zur Vereinheitlichung des Raumbildes, das dort noch mehr von der Reihung der Joche mit kuppeligen Gewölben bestimmt war. Während Penz Ideengeber und Bauleiter war, stammen die Pläne vom Füssener Bildhauer Joseph Stapf, die Bauausführung oblag Matthias und Johann Michael Umhauser.

Die Wiltener Basilika gilt als bedeutendster sakraler Rokokobau Nordtirols und ist neben der Pfarrkirche von Gossensaß das wohl gelungenste Werk des geistlichen Baudirektors Franz de Paula Penz. Wiewohl die Bauidee an sich schicht ist – eine zweijochige Wandpfeilerkirche mit kaum eingezogenem Chor –, lässt die wohlproportionierte Architektur der einheitlichen Rokokoausstattung viel Raum zur reichen Entfaltung ihrer Möglichkeiten. Der großartige Prospekt des Innenraums ergibt sich durch die feine Abstimmung von fast zeitgleicher Architektur, Ornament und Bildwerken in hoher stilistischer Einheitlichkeit.
artist: Stift Wilten (unter Abt Norbert I. Bußjäger)

Architektur: Franz de Paula Penz (1702-1772); Joseph Stapf;  
Hochaltar: Joseph Stapf; Franz Karl Fischer (1710-1772)  
Stuck: Franz Xaver Feichtmayr d. Ä. (1698-1763, Zuschreibung)  
Fresken: Matthäus Günther (1705-1788)
history: Der Gründungslegende zu Folge verehrten schon römische Legionäre in Wilten ein Marienbild. Ein erster Bau in frühchristlicher Zeit konnte durch Grabungen erschlossen werden. Die Wallfahrt zur „Maria unter den vier Säulen“ ist für das 13. Jahrhundert erstmals belegbar. 1311 erfolgte eine Weihe nach Erweiterung, im späten 15. Jahrhundert wurde ein gotisches Gewölbe eingezogen. Bis 1643 war der Bau auch Pfarrkirche der Stadt Innsbruck. 1728 wurde die Kirche barockisiert. Nach Bauschäden 1750 kam es 1751 zum Neubau, der im Juli 1756 geweiht werden konnte. Die Ausstattungszeit dauerte teils bis in das späte 18. Jahrhundert.
keywords: Pfarrkirche; Marienwallfahrt; Deckenfresken; Rokoko;

en.name: Wilten Basilica (Parish Church of the Immaculate Conception)
names: Our Lady Under the Four Columns
description: The architectural character of Wilten parish church is a typical work of Penz, with a clear and simple ground plan, balanced proportions and a harmonious spatial arrangement, all carefully calculated to generate a pleasing prospect. The further development of the scheme of the Innsbruck city parish church resulted in a unification of the spatial image, which in Innsbruck was more clearly characterised by the sequence of bays with cupola-like vaults. While Penz supplied ideas and acted as construction supervisor, the plans originate from the sculptor Joseph Stapf from the Füssen school. The building work was carried out by Matthias and Johann Michael Umhauser.

Wilten Basilica is considered the most important Rococo ecclesiastical building in North Tyrol, and alongside Gossensaß, the most accomplished of Franz de Paula Penz’s works. The plain building, a two-bay pilaster church with a barely retracted choir surprises with a magnificent prospect composed of finely coordinated architecture, ornamentation and sculptures of great stylistic unity.
type: Ecclesiastical architecture (parish church, papal basilica and pilgrimage church)
artist: Wilten Foundation (under Abbot Norbert I. Bußjäger)

Architecture: Franz de Paula Penz (1702–1772), Joseph Stapf [n.d.]; high altar: Joseph Stapf, Franz Karl Fischer (1710–1772); stuccowork: Franz Xaver Feichtmayr the elder (1698–1763, attributed) and Johann Michael Feichtmayr (1696–1772, attributed); frescos: Matthäus Günther (1705–1788)
history: According to the founding legend even Roman legionnaires in Wilten worshipped an image of the Virgin Mary “Under the Four Columns”, and according to records it served as a site of pilgrimage as early as the 13th century. Excavations revealed an original building dating from the early Christian period, a consecration was held in 1311, and in the late 15th century a Gothic vault was inserted. Up until 1643 the building also served as the parish church of Innsbruck. In 1728 the church was refurbished in the Baroque style. Following building damage in 1750 a new building was erected between 1751 and 1756. Interior work was carried out up until the late 18th century.

en.name: Door with ivory intarsia
description:
This wooden door is decorated with geometric carving and ivory, inlaid relief work. The decoration purely geometric, and the wood serves as the framework for the ivory inlays. Made of two patterns, a hexagonal, honeycomb-like repetition combines with sets of crossing lines to for a large X-like shape and a diamond shape in the centre of the door; a six-pointed star is place at each intersection.  
Following the Ottoman conquest in 1518, Egypt and Syria witnessed a rich construction period. Sultans and emirs built elaborate complexes featuring ornate woodwork.
keywords: Door; geometric pattern; Mamluk

en.name: Triple-arch prayer rug
description:
Triple-arch rugs, sometimes also described as six-column rugs, were very popular in Transylvania – there are several interesting examples preserved in the collections at the Budapest Museum of Applied Arts and the Brukenthal National Museum in Sibiu, and in a number of Austrian collections as well. It is very probable that in this case the niche doesn’t represent the *mihrab*, but derives from mosque architecture.  
The red niche at the centre of the rug is divided into three pointed arches supported by six columns, on bases in the form of polygonal turrets, with the so-called “precious stones” decoration. The large carnation flower is suspended from the pick of the central arch, and much smaller flowers hang from the lower arches. The dark-blue spandrels are decorated with a mainly yellow ornament of rosettes, and lanceolate leaves flanking them. The main, wide border, filled with an ornament of hexagonal cartouches enclosing lozenges with carnations rising from them, is placed between two narrower borders with flower ornament. The main colours of the carpet are red, yellow and dark-blue, with details in white, red and blue.  
Some characteristic features distinguish the Kraków carpet from other examples of this type: the ornaments are rather simplified, and a clear, precise outline is almost lost especially in the spandrels; the paired central columns rise from the bases as one column, which is quite an unusual solution. Worthy of note also are the delicate, small flowers rising from the central part of the columns. The left arch has a bizarre shape, which is probably the result of an error made by the maker.
keywords: Dark-blue; floral decoration; *mihrab*; floral motifs; niche; Ottoman carpet; palmette; prayer rug; wool
materials: Wool (warp, weft, pile); symmetrically knotted pile

en.name: Chapel of the Rosary, basilica di San Domenico, Bologna
names: Chapel of the Rosary, Basilica di San Domenico
description: The complex painted decoration of Mitelli and Colonna involves four pilasters, two archivolts, the walls and the vaults of the whole chapel. The painters were helped by the sculptor Domenico Ottani, who made the stucco decorations, the capitals and the elegant friezes, and the gilders Alessandro Miselli and Carlo Veronese. The abundant use of gold leaf for the decorations gives the chapel its typical baroque sumptuousness and contributes to the diffusion of light. Mitelli and Colonna started working in February 1655, completing the painting in May 1657. The subject chosen was the glorification of the Blessed Virgin of the Rosary. The dome is decorated with a beautiful sky wherein the Madonna is carried up by the angels and crowned. In the roundels at the base of the dome are represented the merits of the Rosary handed by the Virgin to St. Dominic in order to defeat the plague of 1630. Putti, angels and Virtues celebrate the glory of the Virgin among flowers, in one of the most impressive scenes of Emilian baroque. The altar is framed by illusionistic architecture on the apse and crowned by two choirs of angels holding crowns, one of flowers and one of stars thus following the motto “*Dat flores tellus, coelum dat sidera sertis*”. Three great ovals frame episodes from the life of the Virgin (the *Birth of Mary*, *Mary presented to the temple* and the *Marriage of the Virgin*). This extraordinary fresco decoration ideally faces the *Glorification of St. Dominic* painted by Guido Reni in the chapel dedicated to the saint, just across the nave.

The Chapel of the Rosary was created in 1589 when the Brotherhood of the Rosary refurbished the medieval chapel held by the Guidotti family.  
Particularly striking is the altar framing the statue of the Madonna of the Rosary, surrounded by 15 small pictures with the mysteries of the Rosary, work of many celebrated Bolognese painters.  
In the second half of the seventeenth-century the interior of the chapel was rebuilt with a new dome and a new apse, while the exterior held the polygonal late Gothic features. Between 1655 and 1657 the whole chapel was decorated by the painters Angelo Michele Colonna and Agostino Mitelli, who made the present rich scenographic decoration, glorifying the Blessed Virgin of the Rosary.
artist: Guidotti family; the Brotherhood of the Rosary
Architects: Francesco Dotti (1670–1759) and Francesco Martini; painters: Angelo Michele Colonna (1604–1687) and Agostino Mitelli (1609–1660)
history: In 1460 Giovanni Guidotti asked the mason Giovanni del Lago di Como to build a chapel in the church of San Domenico imitating that dedicated to St. Thomas, in Gothic style. The chapel was named the Guidotti chapel. In 1575, with the Guidotti's permission, the confraternity of the Rosary started to use the chapel for its meetings and in 1589 paid for its total refurbishment. Among the most significant works of art of this period stand the sumptuous altar dedicated to the Virgin and the decoration of the vault. In 1601 the most celebrated workshops in Bologna commissioned 15 paintings that now surround the statue of the Virgin and represent the Mysteries of the Rosary. They are representative of Bolognese contemporary painting style. After the plague of 1630 the Madonna of the Rosary became the focus of a rejuvenated religious zeal. Many gifts were presented to the chapel from the people who had survived the epidemic. In 1654 the master Francesco Dotti and the architect Francesco Martini modified the whole structure by building a deep apse and a square antechamber with a decorated vault and a dome. The painters Mitelli and Colonna were asked to decorate the chapel; they finished the work in 1657. During Dotti's refurbishing of the whole church (1727–1737) the chapel was partially changed, mainly in the liturgical apparel.
keywords: Rosary; Confraternity; Domenico Ottani; Angelo Michele Colonna; Agostino Mitelli; Alessandro Miselli; Carlo Veronese; Guido Reni; Figural decoration; Religious; Fresco; Devotion; Illusion; Plague
partner: Musei Civici d’Arte Antica di Bologna in cooperation with the Province of Bologna

it.name: Cappella del Rosario, basilica di S.  Domenico, Bologna
names: Cappella del Rosario, basilica di S. Domenico, Bologna
description: La complessa decorazione dipinta di Mitelli e Colonna riveste quattro pilastri, due archivolti, le pareti e la volta dell'intera cappella. I pittori furono assistiti dallo scultore Domenico Ottani, che realizzò le decorazioni in stucco, i capitelli e gli eleganti fregi, e dai doratori Alessandro Miselli e Carlo Veronese. L'uso abbondante della foglia d'oro per le decorazioni dà alla cappella la sua caratteristica sontuosità barocca e favorisce la diffusione della luce. Mitelli e Colonna iniziarono I lavori nel febbraio del 1655 e li terminarono nel maggio del 1657. Il tema prescelto era la *Glorificazione della Beata Vergine del Rosario*. Al centro della cupola la Madonna incoronata è trasportata dagli angeli verso il cielo. Nei tondi alla base della cupola sono rappresentati *I meriti del Rosario trasmessi dalla Vergine a S. Domenico* per sconfiggere la peste del 1630. Putti, angeli, Virtù celebrano la gloria della Vergine tra i fiori in una delle più impressionanti realizzazioni della scenografia barocca emiliana.  L'altare è incorniciato dall'architettura illusionistica dell'abside e coronato da due schiere di angeli che reggono due corone, una di fiori e una di stelle, secondo il motto:” *Dat flores tellus, coelum dat sidera sertis*”. Tre grandi ovali incorniciano episodi dalla vita della Vergine (la *Nascita di Maria*, *Maria presentata al tempio*, il *Matrimonio della Vergine*). Questa straordinaria decorazione ad affresco sta idealmente di fronte alla *Gloria di S. Domenico*, dipinta da  Guido Reni nella cappella di fronte, dall'altra parte della navata.

La capella del Rosario fu creata nel 1589, quando la Confraternita del Rosario restaurò la cappella medielvale che apparteneva alla famiglia Guidotti.  
Particolarmente imponente è l'altare che incornicia la statua della Madonna del Rosario, circondata da 15 piccoli dipinti con i *Misteri del Rosario*, opera di celebri pittori bolognesi.  
Nella seconda metà del XVII secolo l'interno della cappella fu ricostruito con una nuova cupola e una nuova abside, mentre l'esterno mantenne le caratteristiche linee poligonali gotiche. Tra il 1655 e il 1657 l'intera cappella fu decorata dai pittori   Angelo Michele Colonna e Agostino Mitelli, che crearono la ricca decorazione scenografica attuale che celebra la Beata Vergine del Rosario.
artist: Architetti: Francesco Dotti e Francesco Martini; pittori: Angelo Michele Colonna e Agostino Mitelli; decoratori: Alessandro Miselli e Carlo Veronese
history:
Nel 1460 Giovanni Guidotti chiese al capomastro Giovanni del Lago di Como di costruire una cappella nella chiesa di S. Domenico a imitazione di quella di S. Tommaso, in stile gotico. La cappella prese il nome dalla famiglia Guidotti.  
Nel 1575, col permesso dei Guidotti, la confraternita del Rosario iniziò ad usare la cappella per le proprie funzioni e nel 1589 si accollò le spese della sua totale ristrutturazione. Tra le opere più significative di questo periodo sono il sontuoso altare dedicato alla Vergine e la decorazione della volta. Nel 1601 i 15 dipinti che circondano la statua della Madonna e che rappresentano i *Misteri del Rosario* furono commissionati alle più celebri botteghe artistiche di Bologna. Essi ci danno un'idea molto chiara della pittura bolognese di questi anni. Dopo la peste del 1630 la devozione alla Madonna del Rosario divenne più forte e i sopravvissuti all'epidemia offrirono molti ex voto alla cappella. Nel 1654 l'architetto Francesco Dotti e il capomastro Francesco Martini modificarono l'intera struttura, costruendo una profonda abside e un atrio quadrato con una volta decorata e una cupola. I pittori Mitelli e Colonna vennero incaricati di dipingere la cappella e finirono il lavoro nel 1657.  
Durante la ristrutturazione dell'intera chiesa su progetto del  Dotti (1727–1737) la cappella fu parzialmente modificata, specialmente negli apparati liturgici.
keywords: Rosario; Confraternita; Domenico Ottani; Angelo Michele Colonna; Agostino Mitelli; Alessandro Miselli; Carlo Veronese; Guido Reni; Decorazione figurata; Religioso; Affresco; Devozione; Illusione; Peste

en.name: A set of two reverse-glass paintings
description:
The technique of reverse-glass, or *églomisé*, painting became popular in Iran in the early 19th century, possibly as a result of imports from Europe. In this technique, the paint is applied behind the glass in reverse order, with the highlights and details applied before the background colours. The technique had also been practised in China since the 18th century.  
Both the prince and the courtesan are depicted in bejewelled Qajar costume against European-inspired landscapes which are typical of Qajar paintings of the period. The paintings are not signed but have been compared to paintings by Mirza Baba, who may have been responsible for a cycle of reverse-glass paintings in the Marble Throne Hall of the Gulistan Palace in Tehran.  
The carved and richly painted frames, with their bird-and-dragon openwork scroll borders, are contemporary.

holder: Khalili Family Trust – Nasser D. Khalili Collection of Islamic Art

description: تم عرض لوحة الشخصية البطولية الشهيرة الغريبة المرسومة على الزجاج في فلسطين عام 1260. واللحظة العظمية للعبد السابق الملك الظاهر بيبرس الذي أنزل أول هزيمة بالمغول. وفي نفس العام بيبرس الذي هو الآن سلطان مصر بدأ تدريجيا في القضاء على المعقل الأخير للصليبيين المسيحيين في بلاد الشام وهذا لم يكن بقدر كبير بسبب الغيرة الدينية ولكن ليقضي على الفرنجة كمصدر لعدم الاستقرار وبشكل أساسي هذا المنقذ للإسلام سيعتبر نفسه كأيقونة للمحاربين الدينيين وفي عام 2005 عرض مسلسل تلفزيوني ( الظاهر بيبرس ) في سوريا ولكن البرنامج تجنب أي استثمار ديني للمادة. وبسبب الحماسة الدينية في العالم العربي وما بعده فإن المسلسلات التلفزيونية ترسل رسالة ملحوظة : المسلمون والمسيحيون بالرغم من حروبهم المتبادلة والعلاقات التاريخية الصعبة  فيما بينهم إل أنهم داعمون لنفس الحضارة وكلاهما يطلب منهما الإسهام معا في استمرار وجودها.

en.name: Reverse painting on glass: Al-Malik az-Zahir Baibars
description: A famous heroic epic painted on glass is played out in Palestine in 1260. The great moment for the former slave, al-Malik az-Zahir Baibars, arrives when he inflicts the first defeat on the Mongols. In the same year, Baibars, by now Sultan of Egypt, begins to gradually shut down the final strongholds of the Christian crusaders in the Levant; not so much due to religious zeal, but rather to eradicate "the Franks" as a source of unrest. Essentially, this saviour of Islam would lend himself to religious warriors as an icon. In 2005 the television series *Az-Zahir Baybars* is broadcast in Syria. The programme avoids, however, any religious instrumentalisation of the material. Given the religious furore in the Arabic world and beyond, the television series transmits a remarkable message: Muslims and Christians, in spite of their chequered and difficult historical relationship, are supporters of the same civilisation; both are called upon to contribute together to its continued existence.

en.name: Carpet fragment
description: In the Middle East, woven fabrics served not only as seating, storage bags, curtains, bed linen and covers for objects and animals, but also as decorative floor coverings. The literature, artifacts and European paintings of the 16th and 17th centuries all testify to the trade in carpets, which fostered the spread of designs and beliefs across cultures. The designs, colours and shapes of textiles bore an implicit message of protection. This carpet fragment, in which onager (wild ass), deer and lion motifs are placed around a cypress, is a variation on what is known as the Garden of Paradise design that was widely used in northern and northwestern Iran in the Safavid period (1501–1722/36). Abiding features in Iranian thinking for thousands of years, gardens and the search for paradise were prominent themes in poetry, literature and painting. Carpets were viewed as reflections of the heavenly garden and as the ideal means for artistic expression that were easy to carry during the seasonal moves between winter and summer quarters. The most magnificent Garden of Paradise-design carpets were reserved for the nobility, and few examples of them from the Safavid era have survived to this day. Fragments of carpets datable from the 16th to the 18th century have been sold since the mid-19th century in order to satisfy demand among Western collectors. A large fragment of this 17th-century carpet is in the collection of the Cleveland Museum of Art (1953.128).
keywords: Safawid textile; Islamic carpet; Persian carpet
partner: The Montreal Museum of Fine Arts

fr.name: Fragment de tapis
description: Au Moyen-Orient, les étoffes tissées servaient non seulement de sièges, de sacs de rangement, de rideaux, de parures de lit et de couvertures pour les objets et les animaux, mais aussi de revêtements décoratifs pour le sol. La littérature, les artéfacts et les peintures européennes des XVIe et XVIIe siècles sont autant de témoignages d’un commerce du tapis, favorisant la diffusion des motifs et des croyances à travers les cultures. Les motifs, couleurs et formes des textiles portaient un message implicite de protection. Ce fragment de tapis à motifs d’onagres, de lions et de cerfs autour d’un cyprès est une variante du décor dit Jardin du Paradis répandu dans le nord et le nord-ouest de l’Iran à l’époque séfévide (1501-1722/36). Constantes de la pensée iranienne depuis des millénaires, les jardins et la quête du paradis sont des thèmes privilégiés de la poésie, la littérature et la peinture. Le tapis était perçu comme un miroir du jardin céleste, le moyen d’expression artistique par excellence, facile à transporter au cours des migrations saisonnières entre les quartiers d’été et d’hiver. Les tapis à décor Jardin du Paradis les plus somptueux étaient réservés à la noblesse ; rares sont les exemplaires de l’époque séfévide à nous être parvenus. Depuis le milieu du XIXe siècle, les tapis datables du XVIe au XVIIIe siècle sont vendus en fragments afin de satisfaire à la demande des collectionneurs occidentaux. Un grand fragment de ce tapis du XVIIe siècle est conservé au Cleveland Museum of Art (1953.128).
keywords: Textile séfévide; tapis islamique; tapis perse

ar.name: نهاية السؤل و الأمنية في تعلم أعمال الفروسية ( مختصر للفنون العسكرية)
description: إن نهاية السؤل والأمنية في تعلم أعمال الفروسية هو مرجع مختصر للفنون العسكرية المكتوب من قبل ابن عيسى ابن إسماعيل الحنفي الأقصرائي (توفي بتاريخ 1348 في دمشق) والذي أهدى عمله هذا لنائب الملك المملوكي علاء الدين الأصنباي الأبو بكري . وقد أصبح الكتاب الأكثر شعبية في العصر المملوكي حول الفروسية والعديد من النسخ المصورة قد صنعت لسادة من المماليك في القرنين الرابع عشر والخامس عشر والنسخة الحالية هي النسخة الأقدم المعروفة. وقد قسم الكتاب إلى اثني عشر فصلا أو درسا حول الفروسية والحرب. والصور التوضيحية التسعة عشر للمخطوطة تصور استخدام الأسلحة المختلفة مثل القوس ، الرمح ، السيف و السهم والعديد من التكتيكات العسكرية التي تتضمن تشكيل خطوط القتال في المعركة.
