es.name: El transparente Universo
description:
De origen segoviano, Torres Esteban representa uno de los primeros exponentes que trabajaron el vidrio de estudio en España. Su presencia en destacados foros internacionales, desde finales de los años 70, le permitió contactar con escultores de todo el mundo y proponer a los representantes de CEVIDER en Valencia, la organización de la exposición VICOINTER´83.  
La obra de vidrio de Torres Esteban se caracteriza por la construcción de volúmenes geométricos de carácter monumental, deudora del constructivismo y del arte cinético. El sentido de lo lúdico le llevó a jugar con la geometría de las formas que construía, generalmente cambiantes. Sus obras posibilitan diferentes ordenamientos que rompen con la solidez de lo cerrado a lo abierto, el espacio pasivo que envolvía el cubo se dinamiza y juega con la luz que se proyecta sobre las superficies interiores de la obra, en la que determinados cortes en láminas de vidrio que la componen, han originado oquedades esféricas.

ar.name: قنديل.
description: جسم القنديل سداسي الأضلاع يضيق باتجاه الأعلى، ويعلوه غطاء على شكل قبة مقسَّم إلى اثني عشر مقطعاً مخرَّماً، وينتهي بعروة مثبتة من أجل التعليق. وهناك سبعة حوامل مصابيح ناتئة عند أسفل القاعدة. يتألف باب القنديل من مصراع واحد. ثمة شريطان من الكتابة المنقوشة بالخط الفارسي على جسم القنديل، عند القمة والقاعدة. تذكر الكتابة اسم السلطان بايزيد الثاني وتمجِّده، وتشمل دعاءً مختصراً. أما المساحة الفاصلة بين شريطي النقش فقد زخرفت بطريقة التخريم والرصائع وأنصاف الرصائع وحُليّ مزينة بالأرابسك. السطح الأساسي مزين بنباتات لولبية معترشة ورسوم صينية النمط (عود الصليب) وأوراق نباتات، بينما زخرف الغطاء بالأرابسك ورسوم سعف النخيل المنفذة بالتخريم. هذه الرسوم والأشكال مشابهة لتلك التي اكتشفت في الفنون الكتابية وأشغال القرميد العثمانية في القرن 9 / 15. إن العدد الوافر المتبقي من هذا النوع من القناديل ذات الأغطية المقبَّبة المقسمة إلى مقاطع، والمزخرفة بالأرابسك والرسوم الصينية والحفر والنقش النافر والتخريم، تدل على أن قناديل كهذه كانت تصنَّع بكميات كبيرة في النصف الثاني من القرن 9 / 15. على أية حال، إن التساؤلات المتعلقة في ما إذا كان الحرفيون الذين صنعوا هذه القناديل مماليك أم عثمانيين، أو ما إذا كانت القناديل قد صُنعت في ظل الحكم المملوكي أم العثماني، تبقى خاضعة للبحث. ويعتبر هذا القنديل أحد أفضل النماذج في هذه المجموعة.
زخرفة هذا الفانوس، شديدة الشبه بالعديد من أمثلة الأعمال الفنية النقشية والخزفية، العائدة إلى القرن التاسع الهجري/ الخامس عشر الميلادي. لعله أنموذج بديع لعمل نحاسي، مُذهَّب مُزيَّن بالتنفير والتخريم.
dates: إبان حكم السلطان بايزيد الثاني (حكم في الفترة 886- 918 /  1481- 1512).
keywords: السلطان بايزيد الثاني؛ قنديل؛ مصباح.
materials: نحاس مطلي بالذهب، مزخرف بنقش نافر وتخريم.
tags: نحاس مطلي بالذهب، مزخرف بنقش نافر وتخريم.

en.name: Lantern.
description: The body of the lantern is hexagonal and gets narrower towards the top. Above the body is a dome with 12 perforated subdivisions and a knotted loop for hanging. Seven lamp holders project downward from the base. The door of the lantern has a single wing. The body has inscription bands in Persian at the top and bottom naming Sultan Bayezid II (r. AH 886–918 / AD 1481–1512), praising him and offering a short prayer. The areas between the inscription bands are decorated in openwork with medallions and half-medallions with arabesque pendants. The main ground is adorned with spiralling tendrils, *chinoiserie* motifs (e.g. peonies) and leaves. The dome is decorated with arabesques and palmette motifs in openwork. The decorative motifs are similar to those found on 9th- / 15th-century Ottoman tile work and arts of the book. The high number of surviving lanterns with similar subdivided domes and decorated with arabesques and *chinoiserie* motifs in engraving, relief, and openwork indicates that such lanterns were produced in large quantities in the second half of the AH 9th / AD 15th century. However, the questions of whether the craftsmen were Mamluk or Ottoman, and whether the lanterns were made in the Mamluk or the Ottoman dominions, remain open. This lantern is one of the best-known examples from this group.

This lantern's decoration closely parallels many examples of AH 9th- / AD 15th-century manuscript and tile arts. It is a beautiful example of gilded copperwork and is decorated in relief and openwork.
holder: Museum of Turkish and Islamic Arts.
dates: During the reign of Sultan Bayezid II (hegira 886–918 / AD 1481–1512).
keywords: Sultan Bayezid II; lamp; lantern; chinoiserie; Chinese influence
materials: Gilt copper, relief decoration and openwork.
tags: Gilt copper, relief decoration and openwork.
partner: Museum of Turkish and Islamic Arts

es.name: Lámpara.
description: Lámpara de sección hexagonal que va estrechándose hacia la parte superior; tiene una portezuela de una sola hoja. Sobre el cuerpo se eleva una cúpula con doce subdivisiones caladas y un aro para colgarla adornado con nudos. De la base sobresalen hacia abajo siete soportes. En las partes superior e inferior del cuerpo se aprecian bandas de inscripciones con alabanzas y una pequeña plegaria dirigidas al sultán Bayezid II (r. 886-918 / 1481-1512). Las zonas que quedan entre dichas bandas están decoradas con medios medallones y medallones enteros calados, con zarcillos arabescos. El fondo principal está adornado con hojas, zarcillos en espiral y motivos chinescos (como las peonías). La cúpula está decorada con palmetas y arabescos calados. Los motivos decorativos son similares a los hallados en azulejos y libros otomanos del siglo IX / XV. Se conserva un gran número de faroles con cúpulas subdivididas como esta, y con adornos arabescos y chinescos grabados, en relieve y calados, lo cual indica que este tipo de objetos se produjo en grandes cantidades en la segunda mitad del siglo IX / XV. Sin embargo, sigue siendo una incógnita si los artesanos que los hacían eran otomanos o mamelucos, o si los faroles se fabricaron bajo dominio otomano o mameluco. Este farol es uno de los más conocidos de este grupo.

La decoración de esta lámpara presenta grandes paralelismos con la de muchos manuscritos y azulejos del siglo IX / XV. Es un hermoso ejemplo de artesanía en cobre dorado, con adornos en relieve y calados.
holder: Museo de Arte Turco e Islámico.
dates: Sultanato de Bayezid II (886-918 de la Hégira / 1481-1512 d. C.).
keywords: Sultán Bayezid II; lámpara; farol.
materials: Cobre dorado; decoración en relieve y calado.
partner: Museo de Artes Turcas e Islámicas

fr.name: Lanterne.
description: Lanterne hexagonale se rétrécissant vers le haut. Le corps est surmonté d'une petite coupole bulbeuse à douze subdivisions perforées et d'une fixation pour suspension. La base contient sept supports de lampe à huile. La porte est à un seul battant. En parties haute et basse, le corps est orné de bandeaux épigraphiques en persan, qui nomment le sultan Bayézid, le louent et reproduisent une courte prière. L'espace entre ces inscriptions est occupé par un décor ajouré de médaillons et de demi-médaillons à lambrequins en arabesques. Le champ principal est orné de vrilles en spirales, de motifs chinois (dont des pivoines) et de feuillages. La coupole est décorée de motifs ajourés en forme d'arabesques et de palmettes, similaires à ceux trouvés sur des carreaux de céramique ottomans du IXe siècle H (XVe siècle J.-C.) et dans certains livres. Le grand nombre de lanternes à coupoles subdivisées et décors d'arabesques et de motifs de chinoiseries en gravure, relief ou ajourage, parvenues jusqu'à nous prouve que ces objets étaient produits en grande quantité dans la seconde moitié du IXe siècle H (XVe siècle J.-C.). Cependant, la question de savoir si leurs artisans étaient mamelouks ou ottomans, et s'ils étaient fabriqués dans les provinces ottomanes ou mameloukes, reste ouverte. Cette lanterne est un des plus célèbres exemples de sa catégorie.

La décoration de cette lampe montre des parallèles entre de nombreux exemples de manuscrits du IXe siècle H (XVe siècle J.-C.) et l’art des carreaux de céramique. C’est un très bel exemple de travail du cuivre doré avec décoration en relief et ajourage.
holder: Musée des arts turcs et islamiques.
dates: Règne de Bayézid II, 886-918 de l’Hégire / 1481-1512 J.-C.
keywords: lanterne ; lampe ; Bayézid II
materials: Cuivre doré, décoration en relief et ajourée.
tags: Cuivre doré, décoration en relief et ajourée.
partner: Musée des arts turques et islamiques

tr.name: Kandil.
description: Yukarıya doğru daralan altıgen gövdenin üzerinde oniki dilimli kubbe ve boğumlu askı alemi vardır. Tabanında aşağıya doğru sarkan yedi kandillidir. Kapağı tek kanatlıdır. Gövdeyi alttan ve üstten yazı bordürü çevirir. Farsça Sultan Bayezid'in adı, onu yüceltici sözler ve kısa bir dua yazılıdır. Kitabe kuşaklarının arasında kalan kısımlar delikişi (ajur), rumili salbekli şemse ve yarım şemselerle süslenmiştir. Ana zemin kazıma dal, hatayi ve yaprak bezemelidir. Kubbe rumi ve palmetli delik işidir. Bezeme motifleri 9. / 15. yüzyıl Osmanlı kitap ve çini sanatındaki pek çok örnekle yakın benzerlikler gösterir. Delik işi, kabartma ve kazıma teknikleriyle işlenmiş, rumi ve hatayilerle bezenmiş, üstünde kabartma dilimli kubbeler bulunan kandillerin günümüze kalan örneklerinin sayıca çokluğu, bunların 9. / 15. yüzyılın ikinci yarısında bolca yapıldığını gösterir. Osmanlı veya Memluk ustalar tarafından, Memluk veya Osmanlı ülkesinde mi yapıldığı sorusunu ise açık bırakır. “Bayezid Han bin Mehmed” kitabesini taşıyan 170 envanter numaralı kandil bu grubun en tanınmış örneklerinden biridir.

Bezemeleriyle, 9. / 15. yüzyıl Osmanlı kitap ve çini sanatındaki pek çok örnekle yakın benzerlikler gösteren kandil, bakır üzerine altın yaldızlı, kabartma ve ajur teknikleri kullanılarak süslenmiş güzel örneklerden biridir.
keywords: Kandil; II. Bayezid
materials: Bakır üzerine altın yaldız üzerine kabartma ve delik işi tekniği ile süslenmiştir.
tags: Bakır üzerine altın yaldız üzerine kabartma ve delik işi tekniği ile süslenmiştir.

ar.name: خمسة نظامي
description: صحيفة من مخطوط مصور عن قصة المعراج ورحلة النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى القدس على ظهر البراق، مقتطف من مخزن الأسرار، القصائد الملحمية في" خمسة نظامي".

en.name: *Khamsa*
description: Illustrated folio depicting the *Mi\`raj*, or transport of the Prophet Muhammed to Jerusalem on the mount Buraq, from the *Makhzan al-Asrar*, the first of the epic poems constituting Nizami's *Khamsa*.
keywords: Illustration; Mi'raj; Iran

de.name: Inneres der Stiftskirche
description: Die Stiftskirche im Stil der italienischen Spätrenaissance folgt norditalienischen Vorbildern (Venedig). Das vierjochige Langhaus ist von einer Stichkappentonne, die sich über einem mächtigen umlaufenden Gebälk erhebt, gewölbt, die Vertikalgliederung erfolgt durch Rotmarmorpilaster aus der ersten Bauphase. Das Gewölbe des stark eingezogenen Chors wird von einer zehneckigen Laterne aufgebrochen, die von 1691/92 stammt.
place: Inneres, Blick von Norden nach Süden
artist: Giovanni und Alberto Lucchese; Onofrius Weigl

en.name: Interior of the collegiate church
description: The collegiate church in the style of the Italian Late Renaissance is modelled on North Italian prototypes (Venice). The four-bay nave has a barrel vault with lunettes ascending above a powerful entablature. The vertical structure is composed of red marble pilasters from the first building phase. The vault of the heavily retracted choir is interrupted by a ten-cornered lantern from 1691/92.
place: Interior, view from north to south
artist: Giovanni Lucchese [n.d.], Alberto Lucchese [n.d.]; Onofrius Weigl [n.d.]

en.name: Hôpital Charles Nicolle
short_description: This hospital was built over 12 hectares, at the foot of the Rabta Hill just outside the ramparts of the city. It was designed by the architect Resplandy, with the help of Dr Bastide. The hospital initially provided two different kinds of general medicine services and surgery, and had 190 beds. Two more buildings were added during the 20th century. Today, the Hôpital Charles Nicolle is a renowned university hospital.
history: The first great hospital to be built following the establishment of the protectorate, the Hôpital Charles Nicolle initially accepted only French patients. Having been established initially by a beylical decree on 9 June 1897, it was renamed after the doctor Charles Nicolle, the director of l'Institut Pasteur in Tunis from 1903 to 1936 and 1928 Nobel Prize for Physiology winner, in 1944. The Hôpital Charles Nicolle became known for its pioneering work and specialism in virologic diagnosis, congenital illnesses and paediatric nephrology.
keywords: Charles Nicolle; Institut Pasteur; Nobel prize
partner: Higher Institute for the Study of Contemporary History of Tunisia, University of Manouba

fr.name: Hôpital Charles-Nicolles
short_description: Cet hôpital a été construit sur un terrain de 12 hectares, en bas de la colline de la Rabta à l’extérieur des remparts de la ville. Le plan de cet hôpital a été conçu par l’architecte Resplandy, aidé par les conseils du docteur Bastide. Le nombre total de lits était de 190 au départ. L’hôpital comprenait un service de chirurgie et deux services de médecine générale. D’autres bâtiments et services vinrent s’ajouter au cours du XXe siècle. L’hôpital Charles-Nicolle est aujourd’hui un hôpital hospitalo-universitaire de grande renommée.
history: Premier grand hôpital construit au lendemain du protectorat, il fut réservé au départ aux malades français. Officiellement créé par le décret beylical du 9 juin 1897, il est rebaptisé en 1944, en l’honneur du docteur Charles Nicolle, directeur de l’institut Pasteur de Tunis de 1903 à 1936 et prix Nobel de physiologie en 1928. L’hôpital Charles-Nicolle se distingua dans l’histoire par sa vocation de pionnier en Tunisie dans certaines spécialités dont le diagnostic virologique, les maladies congénitales et la néphrologie pédiatrique.
keywords: Charles Nicolle; Institut Pasteur; Prix Nobel
partner: Institut Supérieur d’histoire contemporaine de la Tunisie, Université de la Manouba

en.name: *Figures frieze* goblet
description: In blown and modelled clear glass, the moulded stem of this goblet is decorated with a frieze of figures in low relief.

cs.name: Sv. Jan z Remeše (+kolem 545), benediktinský opat
description: Sochy bočních oltářů pocházejí ze známé brněnské dílny O. Schweigla.

en.name: The Saint John of Reims (+around 545), Benedictine Abbot
description: The side-altar statues come from the famous Brno workshop of O Schweigl and Benedikt Edel.
partner: Muzeum Brněnska, Museum of Literature in Moravia

cs.name: Průčelí
description: Forma konvexně-konkávní zvlněného průčelí vychází z půdorysu stavby. Pozoruhodný je prostřední slepý vstup, jenž má nepochybně symbolický význam. Zřejmě jde o třetí z bran Janova Zjevení. Nad vchody jsou kamenné erby zakladatele kostela a jeho manželky, na střední kartuši odpustkové zněmí buly Klimenta XI. Římsy nad kříži v mělkých nikách by mohly být znamením Kristovy trnové koruny.
artist: František Benedikt Klíčník? (1677 Ivanovice na Hané – 1755 Brno)

en.name: Frontage
description: The convex-concave frontage traces the ground plan. The blind central entrance is particularly remarkable certainly holding symbolic meaning and probably embodying the third gate of St. John’s Revelation. Stone coats of arms of the church’s founder and his wife appear above the staircase, while a central cartouche features the bull of Pope Clement XI. Ledges that sit above crosses in shallow niches may symbolise Christ’s crown of thorns.
place: Pilgrimage Church of the Elevation of the Holy Cross, Jaroměřice u Jevíčka
artist: František Benedikt Klíčník? (1677 Ivanovice na Hané – 1755 Brno)

en.name: Ferrari 250 GT Boana
description: Pininfarina did not have the capacity to build the larger quantities of the 250 GT Series 2 requested. Accordingly, Boano proceeded to build 67 cars, which had slight styling alterations, the most notable being a lower wing line.
keywords: V12 engine; aluminium body; Italian design; luxury sports car

en.name: *Marco Polo in front of the Khan of Tartars*
short_description:
Tranquillo Cremona studied at the Academy of Fine Arts in Venice and then at Brera Academy in Milan. He is considered the “grand bohémien of Italian painting”. This painting was the artist’s first public success. He was fascinated by history paintings and Hayez’s manner as shown in his placement of Marco Polo in front of the Khan of Tartars.  
The artist’s hope to join the Italian embassy – which never happened – was the reason for his interest in the oriental theme. In the ideal recreation, oriental ideas, which were internationally shared, are linked to neo-gothic themes which were fashionable in Italy from the beginning of the 19th century.
keywords: Orientalism; painting; Orientalist paintings; artistic exchange; travel; imaginary trips; reinvention; historical events in painting; history painting; neo-Gothic; architectural trends in painting; exoticism; Italian painters; travel
partner: MIBACT | National Gallery of Modern Art (GNAM)

cs.name: Sv. Příbuzenstvo
description:
Modello pro tento obraz bočního oltáře se dochoval ve sbírce Moravské galerie  
v Brně, přípravná kresba ve sbírce Ukrajinské akademie věd ve Lvově. Hlavní postavou výjevu je sv. Anna, kterou doprovází její tři dcery s manžely a dětmi. Mezi nimi např. Jan Křtitel, Juda Tadeáš, apoštol Jakub, ve vrcholu P. Marie, matka Ježíše.

en.name: Holy Relatives
description: The *modello* for this side-altar painting is preserved in the collections of the Moravian Gallery in Brno, while a preparatory sketch is in the collection of the Ukrainian Academy of Science, Lviv. The central figure is St. Anne, accompanied by her three daughters with husbands and children including John the Baptist, Thaddeus Jude, Apostle James, and the Virgin Mary, mother of Jesus.
partner: Muzeum Brněnska, Museum of Literature in Moravia

ar.name: أوشي بينه.
description:
هذا البناء عبارة عن أطلال؛ ويبدو لنا أنه كان مؤلفاً من عدة طوابق. نستطيع تخيل هيكل البناء العام من أطلال الطابق الأرضي؛ ونتصور وجود إيوان على جانبي قاعتين فسيحتين ( نرى منهما الآن الجدران المحيطة بهما)، ومقابل هاتين القاعتين قاعة سقفها قبة ( من المحتمل انها كانت ذات طابع شرقي) وفي نهايتها مغارة طبيعية.  
أما الإيوان فما زالت معالمه واضحة، فهو مكوَّن من فسحة مستطيلة الشكل مغطاة بأقواس متقاطعة، فيه ثلاثة محاريب مستطيلة.  
أحد قبب هذه المحاريب، يشكل محوراً للمدخل، وقد كان مزخرفاً بأشكال من الجص على الحجر، تدعى مقرنصات. ونرى منها اليوم بعض المقاطع في القسم السفلي فقط، حيث بُني أعلى مما حوله بشكل مميز ليخرج منه نبع ماء طبيعي، يسير عبر ساقية تقطع المكان إلى ما بعد بوابة المدخل لتصب في الحوض الخارجي. وبهذا تتشابه مع شبكة المياة والحوض في بناء تزيزا "عزيزة".  
قبتا المحرابين الجانبيين تشبهان مظلة مصنوعة من الجبصين، ومازالت بعض أجزائها قائمة.  
كان القصر داخل حديقة كبيرة غير موجودة اليوم، تذكرنا بحدائق الملذات المحيطة بالقصور: " القبة" و تزيزا " عزيزة" وقلعة فافارا في مارة دولتشه.
تم تأريخ بعض بقايا قواعد أعمدة ودعامات مدمجة داخل البنيات الجدارية في فترة السيطرة الإسلامية؛ ومن الممكن أن هذه العناصر كانت تسندُ سقف قاعة نظن أنها كانت تشكل جزءا من المسجد الكبير للمدينة.
dates: النصف الثاني من القرن الثاني عشر.
keywords: عمارة مدنية.
partner: Regiona Siciliana, Assessorato ai Beni Culturali

en.name: Remains of the Great Mosque in Palermo inside the Chapel of the Incoronata.
description: Inside the chapel located behind the cathedral, there are some remains of column and pillar bases embedded in the walls of the chapel, in particular in the area of the pronaos and the apse, dating from the Aghlabid era (AH 3rd / AD 9th century). They must have supported the ceiling of a long columned room (18 m long and 3.8 m wide) that was probably part of the great mosque that was discovered during alteration works on the old Byzantine church.

The remains of bases of columns and pillars embedded in the structure of the chapel have been dated to the time of Islamic rule, and may have been used to support the roof of a room that was probably part of the great mosque of the city.
keywords: religious architecture
partner: Regione Siciliana, Assessorato ai Beni Culturali

es.name: Restos de la mezquita Mayor de Palermo en la Capilla de la Coronada.
description: En el interior de la capilla situada detrás de la catedral se hallan restos de basas de columnas y pilastras empotrados que se remontan a la época aglabí (siglo III / IX), en particular en la zona del pronaos y en el ábside. Debieron de sustentar el techo de un amplio espacio longitudinal, una sala hipóstila de 18 metros de largo y 3,8 de ancho que probablemente formaba parte de la  mezquita aljama descubierta durante las obras de reforma de la antigua iglesia bizantina.

Se han atribuido al periodo de dominación islámica algunos restos de basas de columnas y pilastras empotrados en los muros, tal vez elementos de sujeción de la cubierta de un ambiente perteneciente, muy probablemente, a la mezquita mayor de la ciudad.
dates: Siglo III de la Hégira / IX d. C.
keywords: arquitectura religiosa
partner: Regiona Siciliana, Assessorato ai Beni Culturali

fr.name: Structures de la grande mosquée de Palerme à l’intérieur de la chapelle de l’Incoronata.
description: À l'intérieur de la chapelle, située derrière la cathédrale, des vestiges de bases de colonnes et de piliers, englobés dans la paroi murale, en particulier dans la zone du *pronaos* et dans celle de l'abside, appartiennent à la période aghlabide (IIIe siècle H / IXe siècle J.-C.). Il s'agissait sans doute d'éléments soutenant la couverture d'une salle longitudinale (une salle hypostyle de 18 m de longueur sur 3,8 m de largeur) appartenant, selon toute vraisemblance, à la grande mosquée mise au jour lors des travaux de modification de l'ancienne église byzantine.

On a daté de la période de domination islamique quelques restes de bases de colonnes et de pilastres englobés dans les structures murales ; ces éléments soutenaient peut-être la couverture d'une salle dont on suppose qu'elle faisait partie de la Grande Mosquée de la ville.
dates: IIIe siècle de l’Hégire (IXe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: architecture religieuse
partner: Regiona Siciliana, Assessorato ai Beni Culturali

it.name: Strutture della grande moschea di Palermo all’interno della Cappella dell’Incoronata.
description: All'interno della cappella, posta nel retro della Cattedrale, alcuni resti di basi di colonne e pilastri racchiusi nel suo tessuto murario, in particolare nella zona del pronao ed in quella absidale, sono riferibili all'età aghlabita (III/IX secolo): dovevano essere elementi si sostegno della copertura di un ambiente longitudinale (una sala ipostila lunga 18m e larga 3,8m) appartenente, verosimilmente, alla grande moschea, sorta con le opere di modifica dell'antica chiesa bizantina.

Sono stati riferiti al periodo di dominazione islamica alcuni resti di basi di colonne e pilastri inglobati nelle strutture murarie, forse elementi di sostegno della copertura di un ambiente appartenente, verosimilmente, alla grande moschea della città.
keywords: architettura religiosa
partner: Regiona Siciliana, Assessorato ai Beni Culturali

en.name: *Triumphal Procession of Charles V Duke of Lorraine*
description:
The signature on this work is of an unknown artist. The composition is similar to that on a series of tapestries in Nancy, France, depicting the recapture of Buda, which saw an end not only to 150 years of Ottoman rule in Hungary but also to a long period of anti-Ottoman fighting. The event was represented in a series of contemporary graphic works, tapestries and paintings, but the painting illustrated here is a lesser known work.  
This allegorical painting represents the fictitious triumphal entry into Buda of Charles Duke V of Lorraine (1643—1690). Set against representations of Hungarian towns that played an important role in the anti-Ottoman campaigns, the triumphal coach of the duke, who was held up as a hero for his recapture of Buda from the Turks in 1686, is surrounded by flags. Also around the coach are allegorical female figures, and on the triumphal arch are statues of the Holy Roman Emperor Leopold I and Pope Innocent XI.

This allegorical painting depicts a fictitious triumphal procession of Charles Duke V of Lorraine into Buda. Lorraine was held up as a hero for his recapture of Buda from the Turks in 1686. The painting makes use of antique imagery and iconography.
keywords: Painting; tapestry; Ottoman; Turks; Turkish Wars; Holy League; warfare; Buda; Charles V Duke of Lorraine; allegory; personification; Pope Innocent XI; Emperor Leopold I Habsburg

en.name: Sidi ‘Amar Kammun Minaret
description:
This minaret, exceptional in terms of its form and decoration, was part of a mausoleum built in two stages between 1045/1636 and 1076/1666 by Sidi ‘Amar Kammun. The construction of a minaret within a mausoleum, previously unheard of in Sfax, can only be explained by the defensive purpose it could have served. This mausoleum, placed back-to-back with the southern rampart, effectively controlled, like a *ribat*, the coastline during a time when Christian privateering targeted Sfax.  
Abandoned, then destroyed, it finally relinquished its place to give way to a new mosque. The historic minaret, which has remained intact, stands in the courtyard of the new building, to the right of the entrance door. Square in section and 9.3 m. high, this minaret, which belongs to the type of Maghrebi minaret introduced by the Hafsids, ends in a platform crowned with merlons. A flattened lantern sits above. The minaret’s decor is respectful of the symmetry and superposition of bare and ornate areas. Its base is made up of mouldings, indentations and architectonic elements: arcatures, blind niches, starred medallions, twinned windows and calligraphy. Through its rich and varied decor and its freestone masonry, which together create an harmonious aesthetic effect, the minaret of Sidi ‘Amar Kammun distinguishes itself from all the other local minarets. Although built in the 11th/17th century, it is a remarkable illustration of the architectural trends in Sfax at the end of the Middle Ages, characterised by the collusion between ancient Aghlabid and Zirid traditions and new influences introduced during the Hafsid era from al-Andalus and Morocco.

es.name: Alminar Sidi Amar Kammun
description:
Este alminar, excepcional por su forma y decoración, formaba parte de un mausoleo que fue construido en dos etapas sucesivas, entre 1045/1636 y 1076/1666, por Sidi Amar Kammun. La construcción de un alminar en un mausoleo, algo desconocido hasta entonces en Sfax, se explica únicamente por la función defensiva que debió de tener. Este mausoleo, adosado a la muralla sur, controlaba toda la costa en un período en que el corso cristiano bombardeaba Sfax.  
Su recinto fue cedido para la construcción de una nueva mezquita, una vez abandonado y destruido. El alminar histórico, que ha quedado intacto, se sitúa en el patio del nuevo edificio, a la derecha de la puerta de entrada. Este alminar tiene una base cuadrada y una altura de unos 9,30 m; se parece a los alminares magrebíes introducidos por los hafsíes. En la parte más alta de su muro está terminado por una plataforma coronada por merlones; finalmente se eleva una lucernaria hundida. La decoración del alminar respeta la simetría y se van superponiendo las zonas adornadas con las que no tienen decoración; se basa en la utilización de molduras, dentículos y otros elementos arquitectónicos, como arcos, nichos ciegos, medallones en forma de estrella, ventanas geminadas y caligrafía. Por su forma, su rica y variada decoración y el aparejado de su sillería, que produce un agradable efecto estético, el alminar de Sidi Amar Kammun se diferencia mucho de los restantes alminares locales. Aunque fue construido en el siglo XI/XVII, refleja la marcada tendencia arquitectónica de Sfax en la Baja Edad Media, caracterizada por la interferencia de antiguas tradiciones aglabíes y ziríes, junto con las nuevas influencias que venían de al-Andalus y Marruecos en época hafsí.

fr.name: Minaret Sidi Amar Kammoun
description:
Ce minaret, exceptionnel par sa forme et sa décoration, faisait partie d’un mausolée construit en deux étapes, entre 1045/ 1636 et 1076/1666 par Sidi Amar Kammoun. La construction d’un minaret dans un mausolée, inconnue jusqu’alors à Sfax, ne s’explique que par le rôle défensif qu’il pouvait jouer. Ce mausolée, adossé au rempart sud, contrôlait effectivement, comme un *ribat*, la côte à une période où la Course chrétienne ciblait Sfax.  
Abandonné à lui-même, puis détruit, il a finalement cédé son aire à une nouvelle mosquée. Le minaret historique, qui est resté intact, se dresse dans la cour du nouveau bâtiment, à droite de la porte d’entrée. De section carrée, haut de 9,30 m, ce minaret qui se rattache aux minarets maghrébins introduits par les Hafsides se termine par une plate-forme couronnée de merlons. Un lanternon écrasé s’y élève. Le décor du minaret respecte la symétrie et la superposition des zones nues et ornées. Il est à base de moulures, de dentelures et d’éléments architectoniques: arcatures, niches aveugles, médaillons étoilés, fenêtres géminées et calligraphie. Par sa forme, son décor riche et varié et son appareillage en pierre de taille qui produit un agréable effet d’esthétique, le minaret de Sidi Amar Kammoun se distingue de tous les minarets locaux. Quoique construit au XIe/XVIIe siècle, il illustre remarquablement la tendance architecturale à Sfax au bas Moyen Âge, que caractérise l’interférence entre d’anciennes traditions aghlabides et zirides et de nouvelles influences introduites à l’époque hafside à partir de l’Andalousie et du Maroc.

it.name: Il minareto di Sîdî Amar Kammûn

en.name: Mercedes Benz 600
description:
This signature vehicle stands out as the “Grand Mercedes” – the world’s most expensive car at the time of its launch. Finished in glossy black paint, the 600 “Sonderklasse” (German for “special class”) was manufactured to carry eminent icons.  
  
The presidential model of this limousine would carry world-leaders like Queen Elizabeth II, Kim Il-sung and former Yugoslavian president Josip Broz Tito. The design with a chauffeur screen-divider would attract other famous personalities like Elizabeth Taylor, Pablo Escobar, Coco Chanel, Elvis Presley, and David Bowie.  
  
With appearances in popular movies like James Bond, the forerunner of today’s Maybach surpassed Rolls-Royce, Bentley and the Imperial in luxury and technology.
holder: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani
keywords: Luxury Cars; Royal Collection; Classic Cars; Four-Door; Sedan
materials: Steel, aluminium, glass, leather, rubber, paint, plastic; assembling, moulding, welding, painting
tags: Steel, aluminium, glass, leather, rubber, paint, plastic
partner: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani Museum (FBQ Museums)

cs.name: *Zjevení sv. Tomáše*
description: Působivost malby se zjevením apoštolu Tomáši, který pochyboval o vzříšení Krista, zvýrazňuje sochařská složka. Sv. Augustin s hořícím srdcem se stává téměř součástí zázračného výjevu. V postavě sv. Matouše shledáváme kryptoprét M. Pertschera, jenž získal opatskou hodnost a za jehož působení byl klášter dostavěn a vybaven. Angažoval se v hnutí katolického osvícenství a patřil k malé skupině duchovních úzce spjatých s dvorem Marie Terezie.
artist: Josef Winterhalder st. (1702 Vöhrenbach – 1769 Vídeň), Franz Anton Maulbertsch (1724 Langenargen am Bodensee – 1796 Vídeň), Jakub Scherz (činný ve třetí čtvrtině 18. století v Brně)

en.name: *The Revelation of St. Thomas*
description: The painting, depicting the revelation of the Apostle Thomas who doubted Christ’s resurrection is enhanced by the sculpted component of St. Augustine with a burning heart, which becomes almost part of the miraculous scene. The figure of St. Matthew is a crypto-portrait of Abbot M. Pertscher, under whom the monastery was completed and furnished. He was active during the Catholic Enlightenment and was among a small group of clergymen closely linked with the court of Maria Theresa.
place: Augustinian Monastery, Hermits of St. Thomas the Apostle
artist: Josef Winterhalder Sr. (1702 Vöhrenbach – 1769 Vienna), Franz Anton Maulbertsch (1724 Langenargen am Bodensee – 1796 Vienna), Jakub Scherz (active in the third quarter of the 18th century, Brno)

ar.name: مخربشات على طلاء من الجبس.
description:
يمثّل هذا الرسم المنقوش يدويّا حصاناً مبسّطاً ذو هيئة مهيبة، وفارساً ممسكاً بعنان الحصان بيده اليسرى، ويهم بالقيام بحركةٍ لامتطاء راحلته. رسم المنظر الجانبي للحيوان بعناية؛ فالعُرف ممثّل بخطوط صغيرة ومائلة على شكل أشعّة؛ والقائمة الخلفيّة للحصان مرفوعة؛ والعضد والوظيف يشكّلان حرف الفاء اللاتيني "V" مقلوبا، بينما انمحى كل من الحوشب والحافر تماماً.  
نفذ رسم الفارس بإيجاز وهو قليل الوضوح. ويبدو أن الفنان قد باشر برسم شخص نميز جذعه مجابهة بينما نرى الساق اليمنى والرأس من الجانب؛ ÷ذا الأخير مُعمّم والوجه مغطى، والحصان عربيّ أصيل، ويتجلّى ذلك من خلال ملاحظة ملامح الرأس ودقّة العنق والأطراف، وهو رسم فريد من نوعه في الفن الإفريقي (التونسي). الهيئة العامّة للحصان وبعض حركاته موجودة على كأس خلافيّة أمويّة مصدرها مدينة إليفيرا في إسبانيا.

يتعلق الأمر برسم منحوت باليد، يمثل حصانا عربيا ذا هيئة جليلة، بالكاد يظهر فارسه. هذا الرسم وحيد في الفن الإفريقي (التونسي)؛ ويتم النظر إلى الحيوان المرسوم بعناية من الجانب؛ وجرت الإشارة إلى عرفه ببعض الخطوط المائلة والمشعة.
dates: النصف الثاني من القرن 4 والنصف الأول من القرن 5 الهجري / القرن 10 والقرن 11 الميلادي.
place: عثر على القطعة خلال عمليات الحفر في صبرة المنصوريّة؛القيروان.
keywords: زخرفة تصويريّة؛ جبس منقوش.

en.name: Plaster graffito.
description:
This is an engraving of a stylised horse of majestic demeanour. A rider holds the reins with his left hand and seems to be about to mount. The carefully drawn animal is seen depicted in profile. Its mane is indicated with a few short lines projecting from the neck. The left back leg is slightly raised and the left forearm and cannon-bone are elevated to form an inverted V-shape. The fetlock and hoof have been completely effaced.  
The rider is sketchily drawn and very faint. The artist seems to have drawn a man whose torso is set frontally whereas the right leg and the head are in profile. He wears a turban and his face is covered. The horse is typically Arab distinguished by the shape of its head and the gracefulness of its neck and legs. This drawing is unique in Ifriqiyan art. The overall posture of the horse is similar to an image on an Umayyad *caliph*'s goblet from Madinat Elvira in Spain.

This is a hand-carved engraving of a majestic Arab horse, whose rider is barely visible, and is a drawing unique in Ifriqiyan art. The carefully drawn animal is seen in profile, with its mane rendered using oblique and radiating strokes.
dates: Hegira, second half of the 4th–first half of the 5th centuries / AD 10th–11th centuries.
keywords: Figurative decoration

es.name: Grafito en yeso.
description:
El dibujo, grabado a mano, representa un caballo estilizado de majestuoso porte. Un caballero sujeta las riendas con la mano izquierda y, por su gesto, da la impresión de estar a punto de montar sobre el caballo.  
Dibujado delicadamente, el animal aparece de perfil. Unos pequeños trazos oblicuos y radiantes dibujan su crin. El miembro posterior izquierdo del caballo está ligeramente levantado, mientras que el anterior izquierdo está completamente alzado formando una V invertida, aunque la pezuña se ha borrado por completo. El caballero, escuetamente dibujado, es apenas visible. El artista ha realizado el bosquejo de un personaje del cual sólo se aprecia el torso visto de frente; la pierna derecha y la cabeza, de perfil. Lleva un turbante y el rostro cubierto.  
El caballo parece típicamente árabe, tanto por los rasgos de su cabeza como por la esbeltez de su cuello y miembros. Este dibujo es único en el arte de Ifriqiya. El aspecto general del caballo y algunos de sus gestos aparecen también en una copa califal omeya procedente de la ciudad de Elvira, en España.

El dibujo, manual, representa un caballo árabe de majestuoso porte. Su jinete es apenas visible. El animal, dibujado delicadamente, aparece de perfil; unos pequeños trazos oblicuos y radiantes dibujan su crin. Este dibujo es único en el arte de Ifriqiya.
dates: Segunda mitad del siglo IV-primera mitad del V de la Hégira / X-XI d. C.
keywords: Decoración figurativa

fr.name: Graffiti sur enduit de plâtre.
description: Le dessin gravé à la main représente un cheval stylisé à l'allure majestueuse. Un cavalier tient les rênes de la main gauche et semble esquisser un geste pour chevaucher sa monture. L'animal dessiné avec soin est vu de profil. Sa crinière est indiquée par des petits traits obliques et rayonnants. Le membre postérieur gauche du cheval est levé, le bras et le canon prennent la forme d'un V renversé alors que le boulet et le sabot sont complètement effacés. Le cavalier, sommairement exécuté, est très peu clair. L'artiste semble avoir ébauché le dessin d'un personnage dont on discerne le torse vu de face, la jambe droite et la tête vue de profil ; elle est enturbannée, alors que le visage est couvert. Le cheval paraît typiquement arabe en se référant aux traits de sa tête et à la finesse de son encolure et de ses membres. Ce dessin est unique dans l'art ifriqiyen. L'allure générale du cheval et certains de ses gestes paraissent dans une coupe califale omeyyade provenant de Madinat Elvira en Espagne.

Il s'agit d'un dessin gravé à la main représentant un cheval arabe d'allure majestueuse. Son cavalier est à peine visible. Ce dessin est unique dans l'art ifriqiyen. L'animal dessiné avec soin est vu de profil, sa crinière est indiquée par quelques traits obliques et rayonnants.
dates: seconde moitié du IVe-première moitié du IVe siècle de l’Hégire (Xe-XIe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: Décoration figurative

en.name: Yeşil Mosque
description:
Halil Hayreddin Pasha, of the Çandarlı family, is among the most famous civil servants to act as *vizier* during the century following the founding of the Ottoman State. In the first days after he was appointed *vizier* in the year 1372, he was awarded the duty of putting down a rebellion initiated by the governor of Selanik (Thessalonica); this is noteworthy because, before him the *viziers* did not interfere with military affairs. Contemporary local and foreign sources relate that Halil Hayreddin Pasha had quite a lot of influence over Sultan Murad I. After Murad I had ascended to the throne, Halil Hayreddin Pasha was appointed *kadıasker* and he had a positive effect on the new arrangement of the army. Likewise, when not enough soldiers were found for the army, with Halil Hayreddin Pasha’s recommendation, young Christian prisoners of war were first educated and then taken into the army. He proposed the establishment of a class of soldiers known as *Yeniçeri Ocağı*, Jannissary Corps, that constituted the Ottoman army’s main striking forces for centuries thereafter.  
Halil Hayreddin Pasha, who received his education in a *madrasa*, initiated the protection of artists and scholars. He acted as *kadı* in Bilecik, İznik, and Bursa. Yeşil Mosque, which he started building in İznik in 1378, shows elaborate craftsmanship. It is understood that construction of the mosque continued for many years, although the reasons for the delay are not known. The inscription above the entrance of the prayer hall relates that the mosque was constructed by Çandarlı Halil Hayreddin in the year 1378 during the time of Sultan Murad I. However, another inscription above the entrance to the portico reads that the mosque built by the then deceased Hayreddin Pasha, was completed in 1392. This inscription also states that an architect by the name of Haci ibn Musa constructed the building.  
Standing in a lovely and well-attended park, this beautiful structure with its domes and coloured minaret is exhilarating. On the outside it is faced entirely with marble; the roof and domes are covered with lead sheets. The brick minaret resting on a prismatic marble base is decorated with zigzags formed by turquoise and dark-purple glazed and unglazed bricks, and bands of tile mosaic. The beautifully carved frieze along the eaves and the mouldings on the window frames reminds one of mouldings from ancient buildings. The portico’s marble banisters, which suffered significant damage during the Greek occupation in 1919-1922, were replaced in the latest restorations. The columns bear wonderful capitals, with a decoration similar to the band along the eaves; and the frame of the unusual false door in the middle is striking. The central bay of the portico is covered with a fluted dome. On entering the prayer hall, the visitor is faced with two other columns and arches, beyond which is the main part surmounted with a dome rising above a cornice of Turkish triangles. This is a very interesting feature because with this additional three-bay area to the north, the square prayer hall is enlarged into a rectangle; it is, therefore, one of the first examples of an enlarged prayer hall. Yeşil Mosque has an important place in the history of Turkish architecture. In the 14th and 15th centuries, the majority of mosques were covered with either a single dome or multiple domes, and attempts were made to widen the prayer hall with additional areas placed on one, two, or three sides of the central dome. The walls of the prayer hall, which is otherwise very plain, but for the lovely marble *mihrab*, are faced with marble to a certain height.

es.name: Mezquita Yeşil
description:
Uno de los visires más famosos del siglo que siguió a la fundación del Estado otomano fue Halil Hayreddin Paşa, de la familia Çandarly. En 1372, en los días siguientes a su nombramiento como visir, le fue encomendada la misión de acabar con una rebelión encabezada por el gobernador de Selanik (Salónica); esto es un acontecimiento relevante, porque antes de él los visires no se inmiscuían en asuntos militares. Fuentes locales y extranjeras de aquel tiempo nos informan de que Halil Hayreddin Paşa ejercía una gran influencia sobre el sultán Murad I. Así, cuando este subió al trono, fue nombrado *kadıasker* y participó activamente en la nueva organización del ejército. Asimismo, ante la insuficiencia de soldados, Halil Hayreddin Paşa sugirió que se educara a jóvenes cristianos prisioneros de guerra y fueran incorporados luego al ejército. Propuso la creación de una clase de soldados conocidos como *Yeniçeri Ocağı*, Cuerpo de Jenízaros, que constituyó la principal fuerza de ataque del ejército otomano en los siglos siguientes.  
Halil Hayreddin Paşa, educado en una *madrasa*, fue mecenas o inició el mecenazgo de artistas y sabios. Fue cadí de Bilecik, İznik y Bursa. La mezquita Yeşil de İznik, que comenzó a levantar en 1378, muestra un refinado trabajo artesanal. Por razones que nos son desconocidas, la construcción se prolongó largos años. De hecho, encima de la entrada a la sala de oración, una inscripción dice que la mezquita fue erigida por Halil Hayreddin Paşa en 1378, en tiempos del sultán Murad I, y en otra inscripción, esta sobre la entrada al pórtico, se lee que la mezquita construida por el difunto Çandarlı Halil Hayreddin Paşa se terminó en 1392.  
Esta última inscripción añade que fue un arquitecto de nombre Hacı Ibn Musa quien construyó el edificio.  
Esta bella mezquita, situada en un encantador y bien cuidado parque, atrae la mirada con sus cúpulas y su colorido alminar. Por fuera está totalmente revestida de mármol; el tejado y las cúpulas están recubiertos de láminas de plomo. El alminar de ladrillo, que descansa sobre una base prismática de mármol, está decorado con zigzags formados por ladrillos turquesa y púrpura oscuro vidriados y sin vidriar, y franjas de azulejos. El hermoso friso esculpido del alero y las molduras de los marcos de las ventanas recuerdan patrones antiguos. Las barandillas de mármol del pórtico, que sufrieron graves daños durante la ocupación griega de 1919-1922, fueron reemplazadas en la última restauración. Las columnas están rematadas en preciosos capiteles de decoración similar a la del alero, y llama la atención también el marco de la inusual puerta falsa del medio. La crujía central del pórtico está cubierta por una cúpula acanalada. Al entrar en la sala de oración, lo primero que encuentra el visitante son dos columnas más y arcos tras los cuales está el espacio principal, coronado por una cúpula que se alza sobre una cornisa de *triángulos turcos*. Es una interesante peculiaridad, porque con su espacio adicional al norte, la sala de oración cuadrada se convierte en un rectángulo. Al ser uno de los primeros ejemplos de sala de oración ampliada, la mezquita Yeşil ocupa un importante lugar en la arquitectura turca. En los siglos XIV y XV, casi todas las mezquitas estaban cubiertas por una o más cúpulas, y se intentaba ensanchar la sala de oración con el añadido de uno, dos o tres espacios a los lados de la cúpula central. Las paredes de la sala de oración, muy sencilla aparte del precioso *mihrab* de mármol, están revestidas de este material hasta cierta altura.

de.name: Hochaltar
description: Der streng wirkende klassizistische Hochaltar mit flankierenden Doppelsäulen wurde von Pflauder nach Entwurf Hagenauers und Nesselthalers ausgeführt. Das überaus qualitätvolle Altarblatt der Himmelfahrt Mariae von Schöpf wirkt dagegen noch mit barocken Hell-Dunkel-Kontrasten und Figurenfülle, doch ruhig in Ausdruck und Komposition.
artist: Wolfgang Hagenauer; Andreas Nesselthaler; Peter Pflauder; Joseph Schöpf

en.name: High altar
description: The austere Classicist high altar, flanked by double columns, was executed by Pflauder according to the design of Hagenauer and Nesselthaler. In contrast, Schöpf’s masterfully executed altarpiece depicting The Assumption of Mary with its Baroque contrasts of light and shade and wealth of figures radiates calm in respect of both composition and expressive content.
artist: Wolfgang Hagenauer (1726–1801); Peter Pflauder (1733–1811); Joseph Schöpf (1745–1822), Andreas Nesselthaler (1748–1821)

en.name: Photo showing the Institute of Medicine
short_description: The Medical school at the Université Saint Joseph (USJ) was established by the French state in 1883. The French state provided funding, a curriculum, and professors. Later that same year, following an agreement between the Jesuits and the French government, the Institute of Medicine opened on the university's campus. This was later followed by the opening of many other institutes, such as the faculties of law, economics and management, and literature. On 6 October 1888, the French government recognized the institute as part of a Faculty of Medicine. In 1889, when the school of pharmacy was founded, it was renamed as the Faculty of Medicine and Pharmacy.
keywords: Faculty; Medicine; Pharmacy; USJ; SJU; University; Education

en.name: Rope
description: A thick braided rope made of animal hide, tied at one end to a bucket with a strong knot and extended into the well to draw water. The rope must be durable enough to bear the weight of the filled bucket. It is plaited using several leather strips, a technique that provides strength and sustainability. The rope passes through a wooden or stone pulley to protect it from friction against the edge of the well and to facilitate pulling the bucket. This type of leather rope embodies an aspect of traditional life in desert environments, where leather was a primary material due to the scarcity of alternatives. It also reflects the craftsmanship involved in utilising available natural resources.
holder: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani Museum FBQ Museum
keywords: Rope; water; wells; leather; arabian peninsula
partner: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani Museum (FBQ Museums)

en.name: The Welcome to the Italian Delegation in Morocco
short_description: Stefano Ussi lived between Florence and Rome and studied at the Academy of Fine Arts of Florence before enrolling as a volunteer in the first Italian War of Independence, during which he was taken prisoner by the Austrian troops. In 1875 he, along with the painter Biseo and the writer De Amicis, followed a diplomatic delegation to Morocco. The painting represents the solemn meeting in Fez between the Alauita sovereign and the Italian delegation from the Consular Office in Tangier. The bright colours and the treatment of the young Sultan appealed to Italians viewers. This episode was masterly described by the writer De Amicis in his book “Marocco” published in 1876.
keywords: Orientalism; reinvention; historical events in paintings; exoticism; diplomatic mission; Morocco; Mulay al-Hasan; travel; travelling artist; Italian travellers; Italian painters; Edmondo de Amicis; Marocco; travel book
partner: MIBACT | National Gallery of Modern Art (GNAM)

en.name: Tureen with tray and spoon
names: Count of Aveiras’ Tureen with tray and spoon
description:
The import of luxury objects from France enshrines the Portuguese external relations on the XVIII century. The then wealthy and prosperous Kingdom of Portugal elected Paris as the main purveyor of “wonders”, precious fabrics, cabinetry or golden jewelry. King João V was instrumental in the process and the patronage offered to artists, namely the goldsmith Thomas Germain, was maintained by his son and successor, King. José I. Nobles and diplomats accompanied the royal preference and ordered an extraordinary array of French artworks to decorate their palaces and castles.  
The round tureen, more accurately called *pot-à-oille* style, was commissioned in Paris by the Count of Aveiras, D. Francisco da Silva Telo e Menezes. A product of the Charles Spire's workshop, was made circa 1752-3, one of an identical pair.  
It's a superb *rocaille* silver piece, profusely decorated with floral motifs, *rocaille* shells and spirals, also present in the circular tray's rim. The cover depicts a hunting scene.  
The shell shaped spoon is another perfect example of silver carving, with a branch-shaped shaft covered by spiraling foliage and ending in a richly chased bowl.

Round tureen, with four supporting feet, profusely decorated with extremely ornate *rocaille* shell, spiral and floral motifs. The center bears the arms of the Aveiras family, which also appear on the circular tray supporting the tureen and on the large spoon.
keywords: Rocaille; court life; tureen; spoon; Count of Aveiras; pot-à-oille; metalwork

pt.name: *Terrina com bandeja e colher*.
names: Terrina com bandeja e colher do Conde de Aveiras.
description:
As relações de Portugal com a França, no século XVIII, possuem um capítulo notável no que diz respeito à importação de objectos de luxo. Portugal, uma das potências europeias mais ricas, encontrou em Paris um centro fornecedor de obras, como tecidos preciosos, móveis ou peças de ourivesaria. Para tal, foi decisiva a acção de D. João V, patrono de importantes ourives, como Thomas Germain. Gosto que se lhe seguiu no reinado de seu filho, o rei D. José.  
Uma rede de diplomatas e outros aristocratas portugueses seguiram o gosto real e também forneceram os seus palácios com obras saídas das oficinas parisienses. Tal é o caso da presente terrina, redonda, na tipologia de *pot à oille,* encomendada em Paris por D. Francisco da Silva Telo e Menezes, Conde de Aveiras. Foi executada, juntamente com outra idêntica com que forma um par, na oficina do ourives Charles Spire, entre 1752 e 1753. Revela-se como um magnífico exemplo de uma obra *rocaille*, com a sua decoração com motivos florais, volutas e concheados que se repetem na orla do prato. A tampa é rematada com um grupo escultórico associado à caça. A colher, com o extremo em forma de concha, é um notável exemplo de cinzelado, com a haste formada por um entrelaçado de folhagens.

Terrina redonda com quatro pés, profusamente decorada com elementos *roccaille,* como concheados, volutas e motivos florais. No bojo, ao centro, surge o brasão de armas da Casa de Aveiras, que se encontra também na bandeja circular, sobre a qual a terrina assenta, bem como na grande colher que a acompanha.
keywords: *Rocaille*; vida de corte; terrina.

en.name: Ortaköy Mosque
short_description: The change of perception towards the role of the sultan brought about the construction of the Imperial kiosk '*hünkar kasrı*' in front of the mosques built by sultans.

en.name: *Roe deer* jar
description: This vase is of lost-wax moulded glass with an amber patina. Around its base runs a motif of roe deer among trees and other vegetation. The work is influenced by the naturalism of Japanese art and characterized by its decorative simplicity.

en.name: Vase with curved handles
short_description: The Museum of Industrial Arts (M.A.I.) was established in 1872 in Rome as a collection of manufacts (glasses, majolica, sculptures, materials, photographs, metals, casts and other) from antiquity to 19th century, and as a training school for specialising artisans. The idea was part of the process of revaluation of the so-called "minor arts". Spanish and Arabian motifs became fashionable in the mid-19th century. The Spanish medieval pottery showed a very strong representation of Romantic Orientalism and inspired a beautiful production of "winged vases"(18th to 19th century). The majolica vase with curved handles is painted in blue and red-brown metallic lustre over a white background. It has a long neck, imitating the Hispanic-Moorish tradition, and its decoration shows a stylised floral motif. It can be dated around mid-19th century for its form and decoration technique.
holder: Museo Artistico Industriale, National Gallery of Ancient Art in Palazzo Barberini
keywords: Applied arts; manufacture; craftsmanship; museums of applied arts; model; reproduction; motifs; collector; Spain; Islamic art; Islamic influence; Romanticism; Neo-Mudéjar style; Alhambra vase; production of applied arts in Europe in the Islamic mode
